standing: preparation only; source review and LLM dependency-cone judgments required before reuse

grounds.heading: Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/Existing STDO-Governed Project
Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/Existing STDO-Governed Project

conditions: Entering an existing STDO-governed project.
semantic.statement: Require exactly one applicable stdo_<label>.json for the requested Product scope; nesting implies no governance. Start read-only with stdo status --definition <path-to-definition> --verify. Only if the cut is absent and installation authorized, sync that exact pinned basis and verify again; sync neither follows a moving selector nor edits the definition. Before acting resolve bootstrap, accepted Product-owned frame basis, current Goals, Intent/Product, only affected requirements/accepted design, admitted work carrier, and only the exact needed owner standard. Acquire current derived surfaces when sufficient, otherwise deciding owner sections under ACTIVATION §2; do not bulk-load standards. A new LLM should be able to state definition identity/path, cut/manifest digest, current outcome, carrier/re-entry, actor/operation/subject/write territory, claim/evidence boundary, stop/re-entry conditions, then one bounded ACTION. Action comes last; this context qualifies work without prescribing irrelevant internals.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/Verify The Host's Plugin Copy

conditions: The host loads a separate plugin copy.
semantic.statement: Compare the actual host-loaded root to auxiliary.plugin.members in the verified installed-release manifest, checking every managed relative path and SHA-256, both host manifests and all referenced skills/guidance. Missing, changed or unexpected managed files mismatch; version, name, repository or advertised location does not establish identity. Record actual root and exact manifest; inability to identify the root leaves identity unresolved. Keep host caches/metadata outside the compared tree. Resolve actual method members and anchors through Product Basis Selection before a skill route; installation and skill names do not change the selected Product basis.
semantic.uncertainty: No actual loaded root or manifest is supplied.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/New Project

conditions: Coordinated distribution has been published and placeholders bound at its RC cut under RELEASE §§6–7.
semantic.statement: Select one immutable cut v<version>-rc.<n> and qualified ref specification_methodology/v<version>-rc.<n>, with toolchain minimum and Git installation spec bound to that ref and specification_methodology subdirectory. The example installs via pipx if stdo is absent and forces installation if the version comparison fails for an existing tool. Its parser requires three numeric components with optional suffix, rejects invalid versions and compares numeric tuples. Report and recheck the resulting version; do not proceed to stdo install unless it meets the minimum. Then install and verify the exact cut.
semantic.uncertainty: The concrete release, qualified ref and minimum are unbound placeholders.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/New Project
Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/New Project

semantic.statement: Resolve both templates from the installed cut; example destinations are ./stdo_default.json and ./specification/REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS.md. The copy program requires a nonempty even sequence of source/target arguments, rejects duplicate absolute targets, preflights every source as a file and every target as absent including symlinks, reads source bytes and permission bits, and requires the nearest existing/symlink ancestor to be a directory before creating anything. It creates missing parents, tolerating a racing existing directory only if it is a directory; stages bytes in target-parent temporary files with source permission bits, flush and fsync; reserves every final path with exclusive creation at mode 0600; remembers device/inode ownership; and individually atomically replaces reserved names. On BaseException it removes final paths only while their identities match owned identities, removes remaining stages, attempts reverse removal of created directories while ignoring OSError, and reraises.
semantic.uncertainty: This describes example control flow, not successful execution, whole-operation atomicity or verified concurrency safety.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/New Project

semantic.statement: Use the installed template guide over the existing layout, bind a real Product-owned frame basis, WHAT, HOW, work carriers and every known composition edge, and replace every placeholder. A delegated drafter may produce a complete provisional basis but must return that exact draft and stop for Product-owner ratification; only the owner records and admits acceptance, which copying or completing a template does not establish. Then sync and verify the definition, preview bootstrap with --dry-run, and install only marker-owned bootstrap. The packaged guide supplies field bindings and the frame template supplies the declaration.
semantic.uncertainty: Template contents and Product ratification are not supplied.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/Install The Shared Skills
Using STDO/1. Get Ready To Work/Install The Shared Skills

conditions: Install examples apply after coordinated publication.
semantic.statement: Align spec plugin version and immutable repository cut at the RC version under RELEASE §7; earlier cuts retain unmoving payloads. Marketplace identity is specification_stack. Claude's example adds foolishimp/specification_methodology@<qualified-ref> then installs spec@specification_stack; Codex's adds that repository with --ref <qualified-ref> then adds the same plugin. Both hosts consume identical workflow skill bytes. For each of help, ticket, work, review and status, conversational 'stdo <verb>' maps to portable stdo-<verb>, Claude /spec:stdo-<verb> and Codex $spec:stdo-<verb>. Natural-language invocation remains valid. Chat status means Product/work status; shell status means basis health.
semantic.uncertainty: The release placeholder is not a resolved published ref.

semantic.statement: Every feature, bug, failed test, operator finding, scenario failure and release concern begins with intake triage; its label does not choose re-entry. Start with declared authority/owner routes, complete relevant Public serialization changes and accepted-design trace coverage, retaining exact tool inputs/outputs and unknowns. Judge residual meaning/materiality and record support in the existing carrier; reuse while question, subject, basis and premises hold, regardless of role change. Use the successor computed-classification rule only in a basis containing it; earlier bases retain their own intake/construction law. Repair a helper violating unchanged requirements within its grant; reprice only when the selected outcome needs new governing meaning. Candidate bytes do not choose that outcome. Keep unclear owner choices explicit and resolve only what the next action needs.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/2. Iterate Requirements/Find The First Changed Layer

conditions: Before substantive execution.
semantic.statement: Establish upstream authority before selecting a carrier and derive/admit one run contract from the first matching carrier row. Without authority stop or re-enter; no substitute ticket. Reuse an exact admitted ticket if it covers the work. Otherwise use a durable ticket plus contract under ticket-state authority only for independent state beyond the admitted sprint, or beyond the run without a sprint; use a manifest-local iteration entry for work ending in its sprint; otherwise an intake-drafted contract for authorized work ending in the run. Ticket-shaped means fields, not compulsory ticket creation. Drafting/admission/execution may share an invocation; drafted/rejected stops construction, admitted requires no extra turn/ticket/ceremony. Bind mechanism/authority, contract identity or digest, decision/evidence and authorized durable result surface; assertion is insufficient. Record every result, withheld closure and residual before return. Cite an existing exact grant once without renewed authorization. For discovered obligations beyond the local boundary, mutate ticket state only if already granted; otherwise retain in authorized durable evidence/enclosing carrier, withhold closure and return re-entry plus an uninvoked stdo ticket route.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/2. Iterate Requirements/Find The First Changed Layer

semantic.statement: Base ticket fields are exactly id, title, type, ticket_category, status, goal, change_intent, change_class, re_entry_point, triaged_at, created_at and updated_at. Execution admission also binds target_truth, relevant superseded_truth, closure_law, evaluation_criteria, non_closure_conditions and proof_surface. Record applicable dependencies. Actual lanes come from the Product Definition; .ai-workspace/tickets/ is only a default.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/2. Iterate Requirements/Change Requirement Truth

conditions: The selected class is requirement_reprice.
exceptions: An existing requirement lacking structural realization re-enters design.
Current requirements/design with deviating code uses realization_refactor.
semantic.statement: Confirm Goals/Intent/Product support; establish a present-tense successor as sole operative truth, superseding or withdrawing published live domain artifacts instead of silently editing them. Each family receives Family, lifecycle Status and Category, stable obligations, explicit acceptance criteria and written testcase or other proof authority. Expose lifecycle gaps; design/code cannot decide them. Leave incidental realization choices in design and rederive affected design, scenarios, code and proof. Current code is evidence, not authority.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/3. Start Code Development And Testing

semantic.statement: Raw prompt wording is insufficient for implementation: an admitted carrier must reconstruct Product outcome, lawful re-entry/target truth, required requirement/accepted design, smallest coherent affected relation set, exact grant/subject/write territory, closure/evaluation/non-closure law and proof/review/stop/upstream re-entry conditions. Under an adopted optional Executive profile, Executive owns bounded attention, activation, consumption, Product priority/boundary effect, disposition, checkpoint and next already-authorized action without automatic implementation/publication/new decision authority; Worker owns bounded construction/tests/self-review without automatic acceptance/independent review/continuation; Reviewer owns exact-claim independent evaluation/technical triage without repair/priority/disposition/next activation. Labels grant nothing. Accepted frame basis binds actors, capabilities, authorities, results, scales, cutoff, hard stops and invalidation. An actor may span frames across claims only with valid grants and independence. False applicability omits, true requires an exact result, unknown remains unresolved; a caller list proves no coverage. Use a sufficient basis-permitted direct Writer; material dependency/authority/context boundaries can require coordination and independence can require Reviewer, neither automatically. Executive must enter separately bound Writer activation before file or Git edits.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/3. Start Code Development And Testing/Derive Tests From Authority

semantic.statement: Derive expected results through carrier → triage → re-entry → requirement/design/module/closure law. Match proof breadth to claim: unit/module law, integration/participating boundaries, harnessed sandbox UAT/deterministic composed path, live sandbox UAT/real external service or worker when claimed, installed-development/built or installed Product's declared public path. Begin with the cheapest adequate focused falsifier; broaden at candidate boundary or earlier for risk. Green evidence on the wrong subject, fixture, route, authority or substitute boundary does not close a claim. Delegated Worker returns one exact candidate/evidence and stops; Product authority decides required assessment, Reviewer when required returns a closed result for authorized disposition, and sufficient direct Writer records without adding review. Closure is all applicable obligations satisfied, valid support, required judgments/rulings and no active non-closure condition; review occurrence is not closure. State changes require existing grants; repair invalidates only affected claims/support. Qualification, publication and adoption retain separate conditions.

grounds.heading: Using STDO/4. Monitor And Help Triage

conditions: Monitoring or helping triage.
exceptions: State change requires separate user authorization.
semantic.statement: Monitor read-only in order: verify basis, read Goals, authoritative active/backlog/completed state, accepted checkpoint/workspace delta, tests/runtime/installed evidence/exact reviews, then compare only same-subject/same-basis claims. Tools supply identity/state/delta/freshness; missing producer/input stays unknown and semantic sufficiency remains supported judgment. Continuation consumes existing outcome/grant/facts/judgments/rulings and refreshes only changed inputs/affected support. Preserve original rulings separately; existing carriers retain reusable judgment question, exact subject/basis, evidence, actor/authority, conclusion, uncertainty and revising observation. Recovery separates requested outcome, observed effects and owner retry rule; refusal/no effect proves neither completion nor need to retry, and unknown effects remain unknown. Suspension/conclusion records actual outcome and surviving obligations under existing grant. Default shell examples apply only to definition-bound default layout. Status should lead with outcome and include basis health, accepted movement, active work/dependencies, exact proof/review, blockers/residuals/drift/uncertainty, triage/decisions and next already-authorized action; counts or prose alone prove no progress. Under optional Executive profile Reviewer may supply technical severity, impact, confidence, blast radius, workaround, repair complexity, regression risk and uncertainty; Executive combines these with complete Product/release/MVP view for priority, boundary effect, disposition/action. Frame basis owns scales/cutoff/hard stops; no universal P2 cutoff. Proposed class/re-entry does not silently ticket, widen release boundary, reprioritize or dispose.

conditions: A listed stop condition is encountered.
semantic.statement: Zero/several definitions → stop and disambiguate; unverifiable cut/manifest → stop without mutable replacement; missing/placeholder frame basis → return missing Product acceptance basis; missing admitted run contract → smallest carrier, draft/validate and continue same invocation only on admission; missing requirement truth → requirements; missing structure → design; code/test disagreement → governing authority. When TICKETS §7 requires independence, stabilize the exact review subject under EVALUATION §3: freeze before material reference exposure where method qualification requires, otherwise use immutable identity or sufficient equivalent exact-subject relation, then activate Reviewer. Adjacent findings are triage input, not automatic blockers. Effects exceeding grant are refused and returned to Product decision authority.
semantic.uncertainty: The referenced review-boundary and protocol owners are not supplied.

semantic.statement: Resolve owning references from the exact installed basis selected by the Product Definition. Claude's full-entry loader is manual-only; Codex directly resolves and reads exact installed members. Five daily skills remain byte-shared. Daily work should acquire the smallest relevant surface.

State requested scope from the exact request and Product identities/claims; insufficient distinction leaves scope unresolved. Discover candidate definitions only within the authorized workspace search boundary. Filename/current directory/nearest file/nesting are discovery only, not selection or composition. Determine applicability from definition identity and owned what/how/ticketing/bounded-context/explicit-composition bindings; paths select only when explicitly scope-bound. Require exactly one: zero returns unresolved scope, multiple returns every remaining identity/path and requests disambiguation; never choose by proximity, familiarity, recency or label. Read-only status verification must report matching definition identity/path, immutable basis URI and manifest SHA-256, installed:true, valid:true and no failures. Do not sync/adopt/install, substitute mutable source or nearby Product. Return scope, identity/path, URI/cut, digest and result; only then may caller continue under its own authority/effect boundary. Any listed mismatch stops before effects and reports exact candidates/mismatch and re-entry without implicit repair.

grounds.heading: Product Basis Selection/Read A Member From That Basis

conditions: The Product basis has verified.
semantic.statement: Use the verified definition's basis URI and manifest matching manifest_sha256. Require ACTIVATION.md in standards inventory and its resolved SHA-256 equal to the declared member digest; apply equivalent checks to every selected member. Returned URI must equal requested URI and path lie in the verified installation; path alone proves neither membership nor bytes. Resolve without fragment, then find exact anchor in verified bytes. Missing member/anchor or digest/content mismatch leaves the route unresolved; no checkout, moving-selector, later-cut or neighboring-Product replacement. For frames also verify local sources/section digests in FRAME_INPUTS.json before currency claims. Identity checking proves neither fidelity nor sufficiency. Return exact basis URI/manifest digest, member digest, selected anchor and unresolved dependencies for every acquired member; caller keeps its authority/effect boundary.

Require exactly one basis mode: installed discovers the applicable definition and pinned verified basis; release resolves an immutable product-local RC cut through the manager; candidate explicitly loads mutable methodology source as non-operative. Optional --doc selects one entry; --list prints the registry and stops; with neither option select spec.

grounds.heading: STDO Refresh Procedure/Owner And Task Entries

semantic.statement: Load listed bundle members in order; unsectioned members in full and selected sections in full including subsections until the next heading of equal or shallower level. Narrower owner/task acquisition does not change the complete basis. Accept owner names only from verified standards inventory; the method entry locates scope. Select a task entry when sufficient because full-owner reads have cost. Task frames own no determination: check source currency and acquire missing deciding sections under ACTIVATION §2; route availability proves no universal sufficiency.

exceptions: Explicit candidate mode uses the explicitly selected package and carries no released-consumer standing.
semantic.statement: Resolve exactly one basis: installed requires one definition and verified URI/manifest; release resolves product-local cut via manager with possibly project-qualified Git transport and no moving-selector substitution. Candidate emits '[CANDIDATE] Mutable STDO authoring source loaded. This is not released consumer law.' Resolve entries/members/sections with manifest, digest and anchor checks; refuse unknown names and fallback to another install, local copy, mutable source or nearby Product. Surface every selected member/section in order and in full with name, exact basis, resolved source, full content and end marker. Conclude with the stated Active context message retaining complete-basis constitutional authority, read subject to candidate's explicit non-operative status. Multiple explicit calls may build multi-document context; daily skills should normally read the smallest relevant surface.
semantic.uncertainty: The final authority wording is not explicitly specialized for candidate mode; its interaction is retained as a residual.

exceptions: On a selection stop, only read-only re-entry or setup guidance may be returned.
semantic.statement: Apply Product Basis Selection before routing or answering; Product-specific routing requires exactly one verified selection. Help remains read-only.

Route ticket creation/update to stdo-ticket, authorized requirements/design/code/test work to stdo-work, independent exact-candidate evaluation to stdo-review, and Product progress/monitoring/triage to stdo-status. Full one-entry owning-member reload uses available Claude manual refresh or direct exact-installed-member reads.

Resolve verified bootstrap and accepted frame basis; fail closed if missing, ambiguous, damaged or placeholder. Fresh actors enter there; additional owners come only from exact-basis ACTIVATION §2 acquisition. Read smallest relevant Goals, Intent, Product, affected requirements, accepted design, carrier and standard, starting from available routes, computed status and valid judgments; add context only for material unknowns or applicable evaluations. Integrity verifies neither completion nor companion readiness. With no definition and authorized setup, point to New Project without setup. With authorized installation and missing selected cut, return exact sync command without executing or adopting newer cut. Explain the next functional outcome, distinguishing orientation, construction, assessment, owner ruling, continuation, recovery, adoption and conclusion, routing only affected work. A sufficient local instruction may use basis-permitted direct Writer; do not add coordination/ticket/review just for help. Ask for a missing owner choice only when the next action depends on it; reuse sufficient rulings.

Answer directly; re-entry includes definition identity, immutable cut/manifest, outcome, carrier/re-entry, role/grant, proof boundary, gaps and one already-authorized next action. Stop if basis cannot be reconstructed; mutable source, memory, moving selectors and nearby Products are not substitutes.
Before review activation apply Product Basis Selection; continue only on exactly one verified selection and remain read-only.

Bind verified candidate/checkpoint, exact affected claims, authority, scope/exclusions, evidence population, independence, Reviewer capability envelope, adopted profile triage fields, Product severity scale, time and ACTIVATION §7 invalidation; subject/capability/scale change instantiates material-input or basis change. Reacquire live authority, implementation, tests, fixtures, installed/runtime evidence and material history; Worker summaries are not evidence. Acquire owners under ACTIVATION §2 and review law from EVALUATION §§3–4. Reuse exact supported facts/judgments after invalidation checks without replacing required independent assessment. Determine evaluations from owning applicability, not caller lists; unknown applicability or missing exact results prevents satisfied conjunction. Unsupported subject/basis/capability/independence/evidence yields the exact invalid, out-of-frame or indeterminate result.
semantic.uncertainty: The complete three-invalidator law and exact unsupported-evaluation mapping require unsupplied owner sections.

semantic.statement: Seek counterexamples at authority seams, rival paths, proof masking, failure/recovery, installed behaviour and reconstruction; inspect tests/fixtures/mutations/environment/interpretation where proof can change. Findings and acceptance predicates require violated property, supported entry/state, governing operating/threat model and credible causal path. Excluded threats give no guard retention claim; tests create no authority and internal location establishes no trust; preserve supported input/state/authority/effect checks. Material composition/recurrence requires a complete producer-consumer path including facts, invalidators, effects, alternatives and accumulated work plus claimed operational observations; local passes/semantic agreement are insufficient. Under adopted baseline return supportable severity/causal assessment/confidence, blast radius, workaround/containment, repair complexity, regression risk and uncertainty. Use only Product-bound scales and separate adjacent observations; technical severity does not become Executive priority or boundary effect, whose blocking law is EVALUATION §5. Distinguish unchanged-law repair from governing change; failure alone does not reprice. Review checks closure, adds no ceremony and cannot establish it by occurrence. Project every core value: satisfied has no finding and not_applicable triage; falsified has complete triage or explicit field-level indeterminacy; indeterminate/out_of_frame return unresolved triage and basis; invalid_basis has not_applicable triage and basis re-entry.

Return one closed result with exact subject/basis, claim, scope/exclusions, evidence, verdict, findings/counterexamples, triage, residuals, adjacent observations, uncertainty, invalidation and owner re-entry. Bind reusable judgments to question, subject/basis, supporting facts, actor/authority, conclusion/scope and revising observation in the existing carrier; preserve original owner rulings separately. Return to adopted Executive or otherwise Product decision authority as configured, then stop.
Apply Product Basis Selection before status reporting; continue only from exactly one verified selection and remain read-only.

exceptions: Separate authorization is required for ticket creation, reprioritization, status mutation or disposition.
semantic.statement: From verified definition read Goals, bound lanes/outcome, exact checkpoint/workspace, accepted design, proof and exact reviews; comments/dashboards are projections. Acquire under ACTIVATION §2 and use §5 for state/resumption. Resolve every reported ticket, including peers, to its unique current authoritative carrier; historical links/predecessors/other summaries establish neither lane nor admission. If unavailable report unverified or omit adjacent claim. Keep starting commit, later admission and evidence checkpoint distinct; do not attach uncommitted decisions to starting commit. Compare only against a user baseline, accepted checkpoint or prior durable state; absent one report current state without invented delta. Actual tools/carriers supply identities/state/freshness; unavailable outputs stay unknown, sufficiency is separate judgment, and integrity proves no work truth. Reuse applicable rulings/judgments; resume refreshes changed inputs/affected results only. Separate accepted movement, active construction, prerequisite readiness, preservation/regression, rejected/superseded churn, blockers, uncertainty, drift and next authorized action. Triage may propose smallest re-entry but not mutate. Separate technical triage from Product priority/boundary effect using bound scales/cutoff/hard stops; counts/prose imply no completion percentage. Recovery separates request, effects and retry rule; unknown effects remain unknown and repetition waits for permission under that rule. Completion checks obligations, evidence, rulings and non-closure conditions without automatic fresh review.

Lead with Product outcome/boundary; report basis health, completion since actual comparison point, current work/evidence, blockers/findings, proposed triage/decisions and one already-authorized next action. Identify stale/missing/unverified evidence. Adjacent observations are not automatic release blockers; EVALUATION §5 owns promotion blocking.
Apply Product Basis Selection before proposing or mutating ticket state; exactly-one verified selection is required but grants no ticket-state authority.

Read verified Goals/Intent/Product, affected requirements/design, ticket bindings and existing work; acquire owners via ACTIVATION §2, SPEC_METHOD §4 triage/classes and TICKETS §4 fields. Require explicit ticket mutation authority or return proposed triage without writes. Durable tickets require independent identity/handoff/dependency/reopening/repricing/closure beyond admitted sprint or otherwise run, or an explicit durable-record request; run contracts alone do not require tickets. Determine affected boundary/first changed layer from available computed routes, complete Public membership/value comparison and design trace; retain missing mappings/evidence as unknown, reuse valid classification and record residual judgment/support once. Nonconformance does not choose requirement repricing. Select smallest lawful one of six change classes; exact Product policy supplies type/category, with base types feature/bug/spike/chore and categories ordinary/implementation_migration. Resolve lanes and make one unique ticket with exactly id/title/type/ticket_category/status/goal/change_intent/change_class/re_entry_point/triaged_at/created_at/updated_at. Admission adds target_truth, relevant superseded_truth, closure_law, evaluation_criteria, non_closure_conditions, proof_surface and applicable boundary/authority/dependencies/source-ticket/build-tenant. Ticket is only a contract-source candidate; report drafted unless independently evidenced deterministic admission or exact human override. Creation, lane and active status do not admit. Summaries stay subordinate; priority requires Product policy/authority and cannot be copied from Reviewer severity.

conditions: A state update or repricing is authorized.
semantic.statement: Evaluate closure from satisfied obligations, valid applicable evidence, required judgments/rulings and no active non-closure condition; required review checks evidence but its occurrence is not closure. Store reusable judgment question, subject/basis, support, actor/authority, conclusion, uncertainty and revising observation through existing proof/result routes, with original rulings separate and only affected support invalidated under ACTIVATION §7; create no judgment registry. Repricing gives every affected obligation retained/superseded/deferred/withdrawn disposition with owner/evidence, preserves surviving work and changed dependencies, avoids duplicating unaffected history, and presents a short consequence delta. General continuation does not accept undisclosed architecture or scope change.

exceptions: Requirements/design/code/test edits require separate execution authorization.
semantic.statement: Return ticket path and compact boundary/class/re-entry/scope/target truth/closure law/non-closure/proof surface, derived contract state/evidence and next decision. Ticketing alone does not authorize implementation edits.
Before drafting execution contracts or changing surfaces apply Product Basis Selection; continue only with exactly one verified selection, which grants no work or mutation authority.

Enter verified bootstrap, then acquire exact-basis current derived surfaces when sufficient or deciding owner sections otherwise, under ACTIVATION §2. Candidate source/version-line selector/another basis cannot substitute. Acquisition is read-only and grants no role/operation/decision; effects need admitted contracts. Before dependent action return missing declaring-frame or absent/unverifiable-basis binding with the owner section's named outcome.
semantic.uncertainty: The acquisition owner's exact missing-binding outcome is outside supplied text.

grounds.heading: STDO Work/Classify From The Available Evidence

semantic.statement: Apply exact-basis intake/construction law and declared source/worksite/proof tools for owner/authority-layer routes, complete relevant Public membership/value deltas and design trace coverage; bind inputs, producer, outputs and freshness. File diff alone is not Public comparison and trace presence is not sufficiency. Missing targets/serialization/mappings stay unknown; invent no result and do not treat distribution manager as worksite analyzer. Reuse applicable facts/judgments after checking question, subject, basis, support and revising observation; role change alone needs no reclassification. Judge only residual needed for smallest lawful path, recording once; unresolved choices remain with owners. Use one bounded discriminator when sufficient. Reject/repair helper violations of unchanged Public requirements inside grant; changed governing meaning requires requirement-owner re-entry. Bytes choose no outcome and enlarge no grant.

Establish upstream work authority first or stop before carrier selection. Select first applicable source: covering exact admitted durable ticket; otherwise authorized durable ticket for independent state beyond sprint or run; otherwise admitted sprint plus local iteration for work ending by sprint close; otherwise current-run intake draft. Do not automatically invoke ticketing; absence neither requires nor authorizes it. Bind Goal/exact instruction, change_intent/class/re-entry, target_truth/relevant superseded_truth, closure_law, governing requirement/design, checkpoint, affected relation set/write territory, criteria/non-closure/proof and authorized available Product durable result surface; absent surface refuses admission. Validate exact contract; only deterministic admission or exact human override permits continuation, supported by mechanism/authority, identity/digest, decision/evidence. Presence, active status, generic request and self-draft are insufficient; missing coordinates stop. Cite covering existing exact grants without new approval. Re-enter first changed layer: requirement successor becomes sole truth with published predecessor superseded/withdrawn; structural design admitted before reliance; realization proves unchanged Goals/Intent/Product/requirements/design. New beyond-boundary obligations get ticket mutation only under exact grant; otherwise retain in authorized durable evidence/enclosing carrier, withhold closure and return re-entry/uninvoked stdo-ticket route. Chat alone is not durable evidence.

Use accepted frame basis and affected-owner conditions for required evaluations. Known false omits; unknown requires bounded resolution or explicit residual and withholds dependent claim until evidence/owner decision; absent required results never satisfy, and frame availability never mandates activation. Use direct Writer without added coordinator/Reviewer/durable ticket when basis and sufficient context/grant permit. Material dependency/authority/context boundaries activate configured coordination; Executive edits no files/Git before separately bound Writer activation, and real independence requires independent capable actor. One exact Writer grant may cover declared construction/status/checkpoint; record actual transitions, refresh on material change, and do not reactivate or rehash for unchanged status. Work in smallest coherent causal cone and exact write territory, reading material producers/consumers/owners across the cone within access grant; narrow writes do not narrow reasoning. Return cross-territory repairs to owners and preserve variation unable to change governed properties.

Implement/self-review bounded change; derive tests via carrier→triage→re-entry→requirement/design/module/closure law. Use cheapest adequate focused falsifier and add integration/installed-development/harnessed/live sandbox only as claimed; real probabilistic boundaries require live lanes. Reconcile authority/design/implementation/tests/displaced rivals before candidate claim. Reuse facts only with applicable subject/basis/scope/provenance/validity; function boundaries alone do not invalidate but mutation/rollback/authority-basis changes/trust boundaries retain checks. Material composition/recurrence requires complete-path and accumulated-work inspection under owning design/optional refinement and qualification of declared workload/operational assumptions, not local green. Retire superseded responsibility; retained mechanisms require obligation/owner/purpose/scope/cost and temporary ones removal triggers; excluded threats require no replacement guard. Delegated candidate return stops; Product authority or adopted authorized Executive separately determines independence under Product/qualification/release/risk/work law and activates review. Existing carriers store judgments with question/subject-basis/evidence/actor-authority/conclusion/scope/uncertainty/revising observation, separating owner rulings; invalidate affected support only, never manufacture rulings or independent assessment by reuse. Repricing retains/supersedes/defers/withdraws every affected obligation with links and consequence delta; continue accepts no hidden architecture. Authorized preservation checkpoint retains unfinished work with predecessor, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence, claiming neither acceptance nor publication. Closure requires all applicable obligations, valid evidence, required rulings/judgments and no active non-closure; review event is insufficient. Record under mutation grant, withholding only affected claims. Qualification/publication/adoption remain distinct.

Return exact candidate/checkpoint, changed paths, affected authority, admission mechanism/result/evidence, focused/broader proof, non-changes, residuals and closed/withheld result. Claim no acceptance beyond grant, discard no surviving obligation and never silently cross delegated return boundary.

conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.
semantic.statement: Govern the relation accepted basis → bounded affected relations → selected computational relations → delegated execution/decision authority → construction/self-review → independent live-surface assessment where required → accept/local repair/re-enter/reject → exact accepted checkpoint → next already-authorised bounded action. This does not prescribe worker model, prompt, tools, search, topology, layout or runtime.

conditions: The foundation-to-law family applies with its stated instance premises, not from finite capacity alone.
semantic.statement: The authored family covers step §1 and refinement §4, with premises a=selected outcome/acceptance, b=possibly over-capacity work, c=declared actor envelopes, d=admitted grant. It labels P0 recovered; P1/P2/P3/P4a/P6 independent; P4b derived from P0/P2 with unreacquirable step-facts premise; P5 derived from P0/P6 with open-world premise. semantic.statement: Bind A to actual workspace and its acquired account, external observations through owning interfaces, justified knowledge and unknowns; account may be stale/incomplete and is not the subject. Bind Z to the owning Product's governing WHAT across Intent/Product/Specification, with descriptions refining it and multiple realizations possible. Declared requirements/calculi govern lawful transformations/compositions but choose no outcome; lawful construction may fail or remain incomplete and proves neither delivery nor optimality. Premise-based proof retains premises/scope; paths may be discovered during work. Keep required conditions, observations and predictive models distinct: none establishes another, and model applicability/adequacy needs its own claim. Strategy serves Z within resources including context/attention/time/effort/computation/communication, feedback delay, uncertainty, integration and rework; planning/checking/coordination also cost. Measures state units/boundaries/composition and distinguish estimates/assumptions/observations. Incomparable objectives use owning tradeoff criteria. Context limits holding, attention limits use, frame selects step material/contract, and destination stays Z across activations.

Compose only compatible preconditions/effects/results/authority, preserving applicable outer obligations across decomposition/delegation/concurrency/recursion. Local success establishes end-to-end success only with coverage, compatibility and outcome evidence; chain obligations/categorical demonstrations retain FOUNDATIONS §4 ownership. Feedback follows observation/comparison/diagnosis/authorized response/action/reobservation; bugs use ordinary change intake/delivery. Diagnose defective realization, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate model or insufficient observation separately; prediction error proves no outcome, model revision erases no counterexample and repairs no realization by itself. Preserve unresolved alternatives; supported repair belongs to cause owner, labels grant no class/permission. Severity concerns consequence, priority orders under outcome/dependencies/resources/authority; bug lists create no separate mechanism. Preservation, evidence-based progress, termination and outcome satisfaction require distinct support; formal induction/termination claims give premises/argument but no universal termination proof is prerequisite to bounded work. Continuing work needs supported purpose, possibly uncertainty reduction/hypothesis testing; repetition alone is not progress. Failure/missing information/uncertain effects/exhaustion use owned continuation/repair/recovery/re-entry/yield/stop; resume reacquires reality, preserves valid progress and resolves effects sufficiently before dependent action. Maintenance may continue under mandate; delivery needs completion conditions. Core evaluation preserves failure, coverage gaps and uncertainty; proof/checking/testing/use establish only scoped claims and required unavailable proof remains owed. Candidate, property proof and accepted delivery are separate. Completion needs sufficient Z evidence; exhaustion proves neither achievement nor impossibility, and changing Z leaves former counterexamples intact. Existing carriers suffice; relation adds no ledger, role sequence, runtime, general solver, fixed organization, convergence guarantee or categorical-universality theorem. Domain strategy/configuration/mechanisms/additional assurance retain their owners.

No separate turn/carrier/approval ceremony is implied. Name one available authorized durable result/evidence surface and record every result, withheld closure and residual obligation before return; chat alone is insufficient and absent surface refuses admission. Missing/rejected admission returns admission_refused with cause and missing work authority without execution. TICKETS §5 owns carrier choice.

Owning evaluation/scope predicates determine obligations from sufficient basis-bound facts. True applicability is satisfied and requires evaluation/result; false is falsified with its basis-bound counterexample and excludes only that obligation under cited authority. Missing/ambiguous premise is indeterminate, or out_of_frame if it needs an undeclared relation, never falsified. Owner-declared disjunction including non-application may be satisfied by exclusion, but that satisfaction belongs only to the disjunction, never the obligation-holds predicate. Frame/tool/family availability alone triggers no activation. Residual semantic applicability judgment retains judgment/evidence identity rather than masquerading as computation. Missing, stale, wrong-subject/basis or incapable required results cannot satisfy conjunction; other applicable constraints remain even when detected by only one evaluation. Finite declared qualification fixtures must distinguish true/false/unknown premises, missing/wrong-subject results and sufficient positive result; always-skip/always-activate rules fail those distinct expectations. Members/profiles/projects reuse this exclusion owner rather than redefining it.

Derive allocation from operations, dependencies, available actor capabilities and assurance; these constrain but do not determine topology. grounds.heading: ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Construction availability
ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Construction availability

conditions: Lawful activation occurred; causes known during admission or activation instead use admission/activation outcomes.
semantic.statement: The cause-selected mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation; wording, timing and preference cannot change it. candidate_ready → satisfied when exact candidate and transition evidence are available, establishing availability only. refused → falsified when governing prohibition or owner-valid construction refusal defeats construction, with that prohibition/refusal as counterexample. incomplete → falsified for candidate availability when the step stops without output because required evaluation was unperformed or undecidable on admissible evidence, or execution ended first; stop basis and residuals identify which. re_entry_requested(authority) → out_of_frame for a needed material decision outside the grant, naming owner. re_entry_requested(basis) → invalid_basis when activated basis no longer supports work. Both re-entry causes are recorded when present, with basis taking precedence. Performed evaluations keep their own results, including indeterminate; planned unperformed evaluations have no result and remain work-state residuals naming unfinished capability or execution. Incomplete assessment never falsifies an unassessed criterion or the assessed subject.

Only the decision owner disposes; an assessor may recommend, but recommendation is evidence, never disposition. accept → satisfied when the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation. local_repair → falsified for local implementation/proof defect with coherent governing relation; the defect is the counterexample. re_enter → invalid_basis when governing outcome, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract or accepted design must change; re-enter the owning relation because the construction/assessment basis cannot support acceptance. reject → falsified for a governing violation or undisposed competing truth path, which is the counterexample. A repair creates a new candidate with its own results. Global correctness conserves every affected global relation without requiring whole-product proof in each local action. Repeated rejection at one unchanged boundary requires reassessment of frame altitude, causal cone, common components, design-versus-code placement and authority sufficiency. No rejection threshold, mandatory round count or review state machine is imposed; unchanged failed construction cannot be repeated as if iteration alone closed it.

grounds.heading: ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Ambiguity outcome
ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Ambiguity outcome

semantic.statement: Record every ambiguity outcome. resolved → satisfied only for a recorded decision under policy permitting lawful probabilistic processing or human adjudication. carried → falsified for resolution when policy permits continuation with known open ambiguity; retain a residual naming resolving evidence or decision. escalated → out_of_frame when policy/risk appetite reserves decision to human authority absent from the step; name it. blocked → falsified when unresolved ambiguity and policy or hard stop halt work; name the halting condition and what lifts it. Carried and blocked are known openness, not evidence-indeterminate resolution. Preserve their domain details, and never support a dependent claim as if carried, escalated or blocked ambiguity were resolved.
semantic.uncertainty: The applicable ambiguity policy and risk appetite are not supplied.

semantic.statement: Use admitted evidence about the subject. completed → satisfied requires full intended effect and established end. not_effected → falsified requires evidence that the declared outcome is unattained and no later completion can attain it: examples include no effect beginning, an effect ending short, a bounded interval closing partly undone, or prior action destroying what the outcome needs; name any part that occurred. completion_unknown → indeterminate when neither other value is established, including lost response without observed counterexample or full effect observed while it may still act; name the deciding observation. Lost response, absent record or no context trace is not evidence of not_effected. End is established by subject evidence that action ceased or never began; if an effect began without established end, record the needed observation separately. End does not decide not_effected: a closed incomplete interval can falsify outcome while action continues. Counterexample and end residual remain independent. Before repetition or dependent action, reconcile uncertain completion sufficiently for that action; not_effected with unknown end licenses neither absence assumptions nor repetition.

Name next moves in advance for every non-satisfied result and admitted condition class, including unknown. Applicable ambiguity policy and risk appetite choose ambiguity outcomes; this section states no default policy and names SPEC_METHOD §5 as its owner. Hard stops are not optional policy choices and halt at their condition regardless of risk appetite. Typical, non-exhaustive classes are violated invariant/guarantee, absent required authority surface, missing declared executional/operational capability, undeclared irreversible side effect and explicit human-approval gate. A declared ambiguity takes blocked; other cases take a transition stop. Adding algebra values does not solve hanging calls, unsatisfiable demands or lost post-effect responses.
semantic.uncertainty: The default ambiguity policy and the general transition-stop specification are outside this excerpt.

semantic.statement: Faithful refinement requires exact steps: each admitted input satisfying Pᵢ yields output satisfying Pᵢ₊₁, retains every applicable invariant, exposes other outcomes without coercion and satisfies the next step's domain/preconditions. Successful exact composition carries P₀ to Pₙ by induction, assuming outer-obligation coverage, valid local implications and legitimate authority; local passes do not establish those premises. Non-next-step transfer needs a declared adapter composed as a step or a specialised contract whose domain names the carried material and whose exact owner authority, context, basis, scope, preservation, loss, refusal and invalidation law are declared. Coupled required relations fit together in some step; unrelated obligations remain excluded; every affected seam includes its far side or explains nonparticipation. Every layer states and discharges preservation of the layer above. Refinement/rewrite requires a subject-owner licensing law, such as declared associativity, commutativity or equivalence; without declared laws only universally valid steps are admissible. Any unlicensed and non-universal step, and any refinement/rewrite relying on it, is inadmissible. Approximate steps state adequacy and an argued composite end-to-end bound; such composites are adequate only within that bound, never faithful. Fixed per-step tolerances alone do not establish composition bounds. A step neither exact nor approximate with the required adequacy and composite bound is inadmissible, as is reliance on it. Material-transition admission remains one complete semantic commit or none, including the cited ODD realisation.
semantic.uncertainty: Referenced preservation, typed-composition, ODD and profile laws are not supplied in full.

grounds.heading: ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Complete enclosing-relation admission

conditions: A material transition is admitted.
semantic.statement: Derive and validate completeness from authoritative inputs; caller/owner assertions of completeness, validity, prior admission or authority do not establish truth. Bind one exact admission-valid authoritative basis through admission. If validity/currentness can advance after preflight, require the declared predecessor/currentness commit condition or effect-free re-entry into derivation and validation. Participating owners bind equal bases or a design-declared coherent composite; independently valid mixed-basis judgments cannot combine. Validate every participant and join before any effect. No subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth; failure/interruption admits the entire transition or none. Direct, supported composite and nested realisations preserve this law; partial results cannot replace an owner's derivation/validation and competing same-scope paths cannot establish transition outside the governing relation. Same-basis reconstruction and replay exactly reproduce enclosing relation, basis identity and complete semantic outcome/refusal. The law is false for asserted-only completeness, omitted relevant participant/join/seam, unidentified/stale/incoherently mixed basis, advancing currentness without condition or effect-free re-entry, premature effect, exposed subset, differing reconstruction or remaining competing authority.

grounds.heading: ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Standing structural qualification
ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Standing structural qualification

conditions: Cases fall within accepted design's supported input, state and operating or threat model.

Direct cases derive, validate and admit the complete relation once. Every supported composite/nested constituent and owner boundary obeys the same law; unsupported forms need design-grounded not_applicable and no weaker/competing path. Reachable forged identity, membership, equality or authority is refused without effect; exclusion requires owning authority, not helper inability. Unresolved participant/join/seam/relation identity is refused without effect. Stale input is refused; preflight-to-admission advancement causes effect-free re-entry. Incoherent multi-owner bases are refused without effect. Competing same-scope paths cannot establish transition. Fresh process/reconstruction and exact replay reproduce relation, basis and complete outcome/refusal. After successful validation, observe interruption/failure at every materially distinct commit/publication boundary capable of exposing subsets, then reconstruct all or none. An indivisible commit unit requires established boundary and observations immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation failure is not post-validation atomic-failure evidence. A standing claim is false if any owner/supported boundary is omitted, any distinct partial-failure boundary lacks observation or coverage proof, a weaker helper/manufactured refusal is used, or reconstruction omits complete semantic comparison.

semantic.statement: Resumption recovers applicable progress, checks every reused result's invalidators, reopens only affected support and reconciles uncertain effects before repetition/dependent action sufficiently for that action. It implies no idempotence: lawful next moves for uncertain effects are reconciliation, yield or stop, never blind repetition. Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint and does not enlarge outcome or affected relations; the next already-authorised bounded action needs no renewed human approval. A preservation checkpoint under an exact grant names parent/predecessor, included territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location; it is neither acceptance, promotion nor publication. Restart from less than retained work states why repair is insufficient, surviving obligations/evidence and changed causal assumptions; reconstructability alone does not choose restart. Counts of paperwork, code, tests, commits or reviews alone are not progress. Finer categories must name and refine this owner, mapping each to progress, prerequisite work, non-progress evidence, churn or forecast revision; an unmappable category requires owner change. Execution protocol is false for unreconstructable context, constructor reports replacing required independent live evidence, proxy overreach, unrelated incompleteness blocking a closed cone, same-process proof of materially cross-process authority or rejected activity reported as accepted progress.

conditions: A new or materially changed realisation boundary is governed by a design profile.
