semantic.statement: Evidence feedback cannot select/accept semantic answers. Assertion and execution provenance remain separate; agreement may share error and disagreement requires diagnosis. When the design's co-evolution condition holds, chains may proceed together without implementation semantic authority; design owns structural HOW. Incomplete design gates retained implementation at acceptance of the smallest causally closed affected decision set. For probabilistic/agentic construction, ACTIVATION §1 owns accepted-design handoff into bounded construction, assessment, disposition, checkpoint and continuation; the profile supplies governing-frame, transformation-admission, invariant-reconstruction, computational-realisation and module evidence, not a second protocol.
semantic.uncertainty: The design co-evolution condition and referenced execution protocol are not supplied.

conditions: Design-profile completeness, promotion or closure is claimed.
semantic.statement: Implementation must trace to accepted ontology, design and module assets; tests to module ownership. Reconcile implementation-first discoveries into ontology and domain/sequence/state evidence before promotion/closure; hidden controllers or alternative authority cannot compensate for unrealised constructors. Implementation-discovered tests must re-express closure proof against ownership; module boundaries enable common audit without outranking constitutional truth/ratified design. Minimum chain: constitutional WHAT; accepted ontology; target design; target module assets and ontology-derived carriers; accepted domain/sequence/state projections with axiom evaluation; implementation; tests from the same ontology/boundary. With reference realisation: constitutional WHAT; reference design; accepted target ontology plus reference mapping; target design mapping; target module assets/carriers; accepted domain/sequence/state projections with axiom evaluation; implementation/tests from the same ontology. Jumping from design/code to tests without reconstructing module boundaries yields too-weak proof.

conditions: Unit tests are under the design profile.
semantic.statement: Tests should trace to accepted ontology and applicable entity/lifecycle/authority/function/effect/projection law, module design, active or equivalent carrier inventory, module-bounded domain/sequence/state projections and owned requirement families. They are not primarily authored from helper/private layout, incidental branches, temporary decomposition or mock convenience hiding contracts. Ask what ownership requires proving. Helper tests may exist but cannot be the canonical module proof. Broader integration/scenario/sandbox lanes remain downstream proof families, not substitutes. Transitional slice-gating does not replace the module lane; coded modules without it are not closure-ready. Design ownership does not extend to Product UAT/acceptance.

conditions: For each governed boundary, before design-method closure.
semantic.statement: Design evidence states or points to upstream intent/requirements, build/realisation, assurance/proof, release/packaging, deployment/install, live use/invocation, telemetry/projection/monitoring, retirement/revocation/supersession/decommission and lifecycle decision owner/source truth/authority. Each phase is answered by an active owning surface, reasoned not-applicable, or named Gap:/Unanswered: with owning follow-up. These are evidence states, not core results; bare phase lists are insufficient and named gaps persist until owner disposition. Implementation/tests/artifacts/fixtures confirm only within declared authority and cannot invent lifecycle authority. Missing release/deployment/live-use/telemetry/retirement truth permits proceeding only with explicitly governed gaps; local convention, precedent, mutable state, prompts or fixtures cannot close them.

exceptions: An exact separately identified proof may establish a specified status for a declared fragment, model or relation; categorical status requires the referenced Formal fragment demonstration.
semantic.statement: No universal applicability, completeness, consistency, decidability, soundness or category-theoretic status is claimed without the specified proof. Principles derive the calculus; subject interpretation and accepted-model encoding are distinct downstream relations. Interpretation/encoding cannot redefine it; a layer becomes a released Product only through separately authorised acceptance and release.

Imported concepts retain owners; FOUNDATIONS owns result values/conjunction consumed by AC-007/019, and models/carriers/interpretations gain no ownership. No implicit method representation, carrier or downstream implementation is needed to interpret the calculus. Equal-spelled F_D/F_P/F_H terms create no identity, import or equivalence. Basis issuance binds actual immutable clauses, not mutable locators. Models, carriers, tools and successful applications cannot amend source principles or calculus.

The calculus governs symbolic-model form: identities/types, exact relation endpoints, explicit constraints/latitude/residuals, typed traversals/judgments, closure/projection/overlay/transformation, subject preservation and separation of structural, semantic and authority claims. It chooses no vocabulary/materiality, provides no semantic acceptance, selects no carrier, executes no model and proves no unique interpretation.

Preserve the nineteen row derivations and their standing: P1/P6+(i)→one-way derivation; P2/P6→scope/status limits; P3/P5+(i)→closed signature; P3/P4a→identity/typing; P6/P4b/P3→authority/basis; P5/P6→results/stops; P1/P6→latitude; P4b/P6→residual persistence; P0/P2/P4b→closure/projection; P3/P6→overlay; P4b/P3/P6→transformation; P6/P3→judgment separation; P4a/P3/P6+(iii)→typed functors/composition; P1/P6/P4b+(ii,iii)→interpretation; P3/P6+(ii)→layers; P3/P6→edition identity; P2/P6→application boundary; P0/P2/P4b/P6+(i,iii)→constraint surfaces; P6→law qualification. Owner choices remain explicit: this member owns a_c identities/name, eight record kinds/shapes, dual-cause refusal policy, edition shape/RFC8785/SHA-256/reference order and minimum ten qualification obligations with positive/refusal cases per law. Signatures own sorts/domains/kinds/qualifiers/symmetry, constraint judgment, residual domains, stop contracts and permitted functors; individual owners own composite bases, latitude, dispositions, overlays, transformations/preservation and operation authority. Applying evaluation/activation owns closure seeds/relation families; downstream subject authority owns interpretation/selection/acceptance/currentness, model-supplied semantic-subset decision contracts and application choices; owning Products govern downstream identity grammars/issuance and external Product status; release issues edition identity. Consumers apply only owning rules, not new decisions. References labelled provenance/import-only—including IDENTITY, RELEASE, EVALUATION acceptance, FOUNDATIONS latitude and profile-side declarations—must not become additional applications by connectivity.
semantic.uncertainty: Detailed consumer loci and several referenced laws are outside the supplied sections.

semantic.statement: The table additionally states: every traversal uses exactly one deterministic-evaluation, probabilistic-construction or human-adjudication kind, distinct from actor/executor/domain operation and asserting no categorical functor; typed composition retains both identities and intermediate facts. Interpretation proposes without accepting; admitted records have exact provenance or model-local identification, evaluated declarations have dispositions, structural success only supports semantic review, and valid models satisfy all applicable laws. Encoding requires acceptance of the unchanged model; downstream success ratifies no upstream layer. Edition identity is an external record created after published bytes, binding bytes/derivation; downstream identities bind upstream identities and judgments remain outside judged identities. Applications' selections, constructions, acceptances, releases, imports/translations/specialisations remain external. Task constraint surfaces carry material closure, residuals blocking dependent work, no authority, and distinct validity/fidelity/sufficiency claims. Qualification covers every law with positive and refusal cases and never extends beyond evaluated claims.
semantic.uncertainty: These are supplied table summaries, not imported full definitions of AC-015–020 or sections 5–10.

exceptions: A population may be empty only when the selected signature requires no member of that kind.
A new fundamental family requires an explicit compatible calculus extension.
semantic.statement: Import all eight core identities unchanged; family signatures specialise fields/domains/kinds without removing, renaming, shadowing or silently adding families. Unknown kinds/fields require a new signature or explicit compatible extension, not implicit extension or extra subject sort. Populations are finite, total, disjoint and identity-unique; every record belongs exactly once and every external identity has exactly one declared reference domain/resolution. Hidden records, extra unpopulated families, duplicate identities or identities lacking local record/lawful external resolution refuse the model. Every identity-bearing scalar/collection element is checked by RefDomain_Sigma: exact family, semantic sort where applicable, and exact external kind/basis; never both local and external. Missing field domains, wrong families/sorts, ambiguous targets and dangling external identities refuse structural admission.

SemanticObject, TypedRelation, Constraint, Latitude and Residual populate O/E/C/L/X; traversal, transformation and judgment populate V/T/J. Reifying a record-kind name as an object does not place an operational record in O or satisfy its required core population. Independently representing record-kind concepts is permitted but distinct.

conditions: A predicate is not deterministically decidable.
semantic.statement: Declare the required probabilistic or human judgment kind instead of claiming machine proof. Both constraint and judgment kinds must resolve within the owning signature.

exceptions: Competent authority explicitly dispositions the residual.
semantic.statement: Projection, compression, interpretation and encoding cannot erase residuals: retain them, record competent disposition or refuse. Undeclared residual kinds or values refuse structural admission.
Fundamental laws govern records of sections 2, 3 and 5 and FOUNDATIONS §2 ontology. FOUNDATIONS retains definitions of identity, authority, basis and residual; this member owns the laws over them.

Every admitted fundamental record belongs to one declared signature and occurs exactly once under its declared core kind in total Population_M. Missing, duplicate, shadowed or unknown kinds/populations fail closed.

Every identity in I resolves one member under one type, context, owner, scope and basis. Owner maps to authority, type to kind, resolved member to denoted value; context/scope/basis are additional required coordinates permitted by IDENTITY §2. Equal spelling, payload, structural position or carrier does not establish semantic identity.

Every reference resolves exactly once locally or through one explicit external relation using its exact RefDomain_Sigma declaration. Dangling, duplicate, wrong-kind, wrong-sort, wrong-basis, local/external ambiguous and undeclared-field references refuse structural admission; AC-007 separately determines the refusal's core value by cause.

exceptions: Direction is immaterial only when the relation kind explicitly declares symmetry.
semantic.statement: Lawfulness requires exact admitted endpoint sorts and all required qualifiers; direction is material subject to explicit symmetry.
All listed records and projections retain declared semantic, operation, evaluation and decision authority. Copying, interpreting, encoding, evaluating or transporting transfers none.

exceptions: Mixed bases require an explicit owned composite-basis record.
semantic.statement: Every result, fundamental record and model binds an exact basis. Individually valid nearby coordinates do not constitute coherent composite basis. FOUNDATIONS defines Basis and RF-005 owns result exactness; AC-006 applies it to records/models.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-007 Constraint and refusal

conditions: A constraint judgment is performed.
semantic.statement: For the predicate that the constraint holds for its governed subject on exact basis: holds→satisfied with established predicate; failed→falsified with named counterexample; undecidable admissible evidence→indeterminate naming deciding evidence; outside applies_to/context/scope requiring an undeclared relation→out_of_frame naming that relation and source-given owner; unsupported subject/basis→invalid_basis naming repair. No mapping raises standing or coerces failure, absence, indeterminacy, out-of-scope or invalid basis to satisfied. A judgment not performed has no closed result, is not indeterminate and enters conjunction as planned assessment without a result.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-007 Constraint and refusal

conditions: A closure, projection, structural admission, transformation application or interpretation is applied.
semantic.statement: For the predicate that the operation yields its declared result on exact basis: declared result→satisfied, establishing availability of a proposed model/successor only, not acceptance/admission; hold→indeterminate when required evidence/observation/disposition is not yet admitted, naming what decides; gap→invalid_basis when a needed member/reference/resolution/declaration remains unresolved by its declared relation; refusal(constraint)→falsified for a demonstrated law/signature violation by what is judged or any refusal not naming a basis condition; refusal(basis)→invalid_basis for basis conditions without a demonstrated violation by what is judged. A resolved-to-no-target local/external reference is dangling and refuses, distinct from open external resolution. Basis-only causes include inexact seeds/relations/edge semantics/basis/scope, nonfinite/nonunique fixed points, unestablished input identity/basis/admission or mixed bases without composite relation. Refusal names its condition, admits no record/model/carrier and silently drops nothing.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/4. Fundamental laws/AC-007 Constraint and refusal

semantic.statement: Cause is part of refusal value. A demonstrated violation by the judged record/model/carrier/transformation/application makes refusal(constraint), even with a basis condition; report the latter alongside as a separate invalid_basis result naming repair and the unsupported evaluation predicate, not the operation-outcome predicate. Known failure/counterexample survives conjunction. A defect in an input used as basis is a basis condition for that operation. Basis mismatch—including qualifier or wrong-basis reference—is always a basis condition, never signature-constraint violation, even when the signature declares the basis relation. Thus AC-001 violation may falsify model admission while invalidating the basis of projection over that model. Unapplied operations have no outcome. A gap stop is a closed invalid_basis result, distinct from missing-result conjunction gaps. Signature/traversal-specific stops map under §5. Unestablished closure/projection is invalid_basis for its predicate, as closure_unresolved is for its own activation predicate.

exceptions: An applicable latitude record or transformation relation permits the difference.
semantic.statement: Lawful differences require declared applicable latitude or transformation. Implementation preference, probabilistic choice and human presence supply no implicit latitude.

exceptions: Authorised disposition creates an exact successor model.
semantic.statement: Every material uncertainty, omission, translation loss, unresolved boundary and unproved relation remains in X until authorised successor disposition. Projection absence is not resolution.

Closure exists only with exact Z/R/required-edge semantics/basis/scope and finite unique fixed point. Unresolved required conditions return gap; otherwise failure to establish them returns refusal(basis). Least lawful closure claims no global minimum prose, bytes, tokens, cost or cognition. ACTIVATION §2 applies it to step context under an envelope.

Projection preserves selected meaning and contains closure with explicit seams. Failures inherited from closure/input model are gap or refusal(basis). It creates no semantic owner and may not trim required closure members for carrier, capability or other budgets. Step contexts and this corpus's projected frames are applications of this projection.

Overlay cannot mutate its basis. Override, disambiguation, equivalence, specialisation and translation require typed relations with exact authority, direction, scope, basis, preservation, loss, refusal and invalidation semantics.

exceptions: Cross-basis/signature migration has a separately identified specialisation with exact composite-basis and compatible signature-extension relations naming both sides.
semantic.statement: t.traversal resolves one exact v; context, owner, scope, basis, operation authority, evidence, provenance and stop contract equal or lawfully restrict v, otherwise refuse. Domain/codomain identify complete exact models committing to calculus basis, signature, full populations/external identities/resolution map and owned content identity; mutable locators, family names, partial projections or population digests alone refuse. Ordinary transformations share domain/codomain/t/traversal basis and domain/codomain signature. Migration needs the stated separate specialisation. Changed basis or record kind forces removal/introduction and continuity only through exact migration, never preserved membership. Preservation_relation is exact typed equality binding both models/bases, record kinds, comparison domain, direction, authority, scope, evidence and equality law; equivalence/meaning preservation may relate removed/introduction but cannot preserve an identity.

conditions: A lawful transformation is claimed.
semantic.statement: Prove Local_b = P_t disjoint_union R_t; Local_b_prime = P_t disjoint_union N_t; N_t intersects no input identity and R_t no successor identity. Preserved records retain exact kind, identity, context, owner, scope and basis, with either byte identity under one exact shared canonical grammar or exact typed equality when no shared byte grammar exists. These are alternative proofs, not carrier selection. Changed fields/basis/kind, nominal identifier equality, equivalence or unbound preservation assertions refuse P_t. Every input identity is classified exactly once; every introduction is a complete lawful record in exactly one successor population; removals are absent. No silent dropping, retention or duplication.

conditions: A lawful transformation is claimed.
semantic.statement: Every external identity has exactly one exact resolution tuple; missing/ambiguous/extra tuples refuse. Prove E_b = EP_t disjoint_union ER_t; E_b_prime = EP_t disjoint_union EN_t; EN_t intersects no E_b and ER_t no E_b_prime. Each preserved tuple has exactly one total, exclusive witness binding both models/resolutions, equal decision and evidence, with field-exact equality. Nominal identity, equivalent targets, changes to target kind/target/reference domain/basis relation/resolution basis or missing witnesses cannot preserve. Removed tuples occur only in input, introduced only in successor. Changed resolution requires removal/introduction and separate continuity even if referenced external identity remains unchanged.

exceptions: An exact authorised residual disposition is included in transformation evidence.
semantic.statement: Retain material residuals in successors absent exact authorised evidence of disposition. Failure of any identity, basis, population, local/external partition, equality, resolution witness, residual or codomain equation refuses. Exact t declares every permitted mutation; input stays unchanged, successor is merely proposed and cannot accept/admit itself. Stops map by AC-007 cause. FOUNDATIONS consumes preserved/introduced/removed records, resolution witnesses and residuals as conservation accounting.
Judgment issuance never transforms, rewrites, reissues or renames the subject. Promotion is a separate explicit relation from unchanged subject to its admission/acceptance judgment.

Nominal equality does not import or specialise this member's traversal; specialisation requires a declared binding under the other owner's authority. Actor, executor, domain operation and functor kind remain distinct coordinates. Encode, Interpret, Serialize, Measure and other operations are not kind aliases. Sharing a kind implies no shared traversal identity, semantics, input, output, authority or evidence.

conditions: For every stop value and each cause refinement declared by the signature stop contract or traversal stop_states.
semantic.statement: Each stop maps to exactly one existing core value, never satisfied. Further stops declare their single core mapping in the signature stop contract; traversal stop_states binds its exact mapping. Every refinement names parent and cause and keeps the parent's core value: hold -> indeterminate; gap and refusal(basis) -> invalid_basis; refusal(constraint) -> falsified. A different core value requires a different parent declared only by that parent's owning member; this member owns the four named stops. Neither contract nor stop_states raises standing or turns a violated constraint into mere evidential undecidability.
semantic.uncertainty: The full cause definitions in AC-007 are outside the supplied sections.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/5. Traversals and functor kinds/AC-015 Functor classification

conditions: For every functor application.
semantic.statement: Bind exactly one kind and one traversal identity. An F_* application lacking bracketed [v] violates AC-015 and yields refusal(constraint), whose supplied core mapping is falsified. Its descriptive incompleteness is not ACTIVATION's construction-availability value incomplete.
semantic.uncertainty: ACTIVATION's separate incomplete value is referenced but not defined here.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/5. Traversals and functor kinds/AC-016 Typed composition
AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/5. Traversals and functor kinds/AC-016 Typed composition

conditions: When two traversals are composed.
semantic.statement: Composition is possible only if the first result type and judgment satisfy the second exact domain and preconditions. Preserve both identities, intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states; probabilistic proposal, deterministic evaluation and human decision cannot be flattened. No universal F_P -> F_D -> F_H sequence is prescribed. FOUNDATIONS §3 P4a consumes this law.
semantic.uncertainty: The consuming P4a clause is not supplied.

conditions: If a model claims categorical functor laws.
semantic.statement: Functor-kind classification alone makes no category-theoretic assertion. A categorical claim carries the required Formal fragment demonstration; the supplied conformance discriminator further requires objects, arrows, arrow equality, identity, composition and demonstrated functor laws before such a claim.
semantic.uncertainty: FOUNDATIONS' full formal requirements are not supplied.

conditions: For an exact-subject interpretation contract.
semantic.statement: The contract makes FOUNDATIONS §2 Interpretation exact for one subject and signature and declares every listed coordinate: exact calculus basis; subject identity, inventory and bytes or semantic addresses; signature and compatible extension; mapping to every applicable record population, including the eight named populations; interpreter identity, capability, provenance and stops; structural evaluation; semantic selection and acceptance authority; source re-entry and invalidation. Construction grants no acceptance. Structural proof of shape, references, identity or basis does not establish retention of every material meaning; semantic acceptance remains separate.
semantic.uncertainty: The cited FOUNDATIONS definition and full source-defined record schemas are absent.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models/AC-017 Interpretation fidelity

conditions: For every admitted model record and every evaluated subject declaration.
exceptions: A record may be explicitly model-local under competent authority instead of mapping to exact subject provenance.
semantic.statement: Admitted records require exact subject provenance or the stated model-local exception. Every evaluated declaration receives retained, omitted, residual, inapplicable or refused disposition. Absence cannot be treated as immaterial without recorded basis and authority.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models/AC-018 Structural and semantic separation

conditions: For every review, as owned by EVALUATION §2 and bound here to a_c.
semantic.statement: Keep structural conformance separate from semantic fidelity. Structural success supports semantic review but cannot substitute for it; the owning rule remains EVALUATION's.
semantic.uncertainty: EVALUATION's wider review protocol is unavailable in these sections.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/6. Interpretation and models/AC-019 Valid model

conditions: When claiming M_b satisfies a_c[Sigma].
semantic.statement: Validity requires resolving Sigma and exact calculus basis; every record satisfying AC-001–AC-009; every claimed closure, projection, overlay, transformation, judgment and composition satisfying its applicable law; fidelity and residual dispositions binding the exact subject; distinct structural evaluation and semantic acceptance, both required where claimed; and resolution of every evidence, provenance, invalidation and re-entry coordinate. A checker may decide the structural subset. A generic checker cannot claim the semantic or authority subset unless the model supplies an exact lawful decision contract.
semantic.uncertainty: Several required laws and the decision-contract details are outside the supplied source.

conditions: When encoding a model or combining semantic-acceptance and carrier-admission results.
semantic.statement: Encoding requires an accepted J_X whose subject identity and digest exactly equal unchanged M_X; hold and refusal cannot be encoded. Acceptance and admission answer distinct predicates, do not alter subject identity, and combine with other results only through core mappings: accepted/admitted -> satisfied; hold -> AC-007 hold; refuse -> cause-dependent AC-007 refusal. Withheld or refused judgments never count as accepted.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/7. Layers/AC-020 Layer and release separation
AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/7. Layers/AC-020 Layer and release separation

semantic.statement: The three layers retain independent content identities, judgments, supersession and proof obligations. Calculus qualification tests internal coherence against its complete declared laws; interpretation proves fidelity to exact X; carrier qualification proves faithful canonical encoding of the accepted model. Encoding failure does not change the interpreted model, interpretation failure does not change the calculus, and downstream success cannot ratify upstream basis or layer. Product status belongs to an external authority selecting and releasing the layer, never follows automatically. SPEC_METHOD §6 applies this law to release lineage.
semantic.uncertainty: SPEC_METHOD's release-lineage application is not supplied.

conditions: For the source-defined AxiomaticCalculusBasis record.
semantic.statement: The record has kind stdo.axiomatic-calculus-basis, schema_version 1 and concept_identity urn:stdo:concept:axiomatic-calculus:a-c. derivation_basis contains an absolute immutable package release_uri, manifest_sha256 and nonempty absolute semantic-address principle_refs. publication_basis contains the same release_uri, manifest_sha256, absolute member_uri within that release and member_sha256. Each digest field is 'sha256:' plus 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reject duplicate object names before RFC 8785 JCS canonicalisation; principle_refs is duplicate-free and sorted ascending by unsigned UTF-16 code units. Identity is urn:stdo:axiomatic-calculus-basis:sha256: followed by sha256(JCS(AxiomaticCalculusBasis)).
semantic.uncertainty: No basis record is constructed or its identity calculated here.

semantic.statement: derivation_basis binds the complete finite governing-clause set identified by §1 Derivation provenance; recompute it when clauses change, never infer it from a hard-coded member count. Every reference resolves within publication_basis's exact package, with equal release_uri and manifest_sha256 across both roles; co-publication does not transfer premise ownership. publication_basis binds exact member bytes at a member_uri within its release. Every release_uri has immutable stdo://releases/v<version>-rc.<positive-ordinal>/ form. Acceptance is a verdict over that cut, not another identity; record presence grants no acceptance or release status. Outside-package references, missing/ambiguous clauses, extra undeclared premises and digest mismatches invalidate the record. Issue only after frozen member set and manifest; keep the record outside both hashed member set and member bytes. It may accompany them as external metadata, but neither member nor manifest embeds its identity or final bytes. The record hashes already-fixed coordinates without reverse dependency.
semantic.uncertainty: The actual §1 premise inventory and RELEASE issuance/acceptance rules are not supplied.

conditions: For downstream identities and dependencies on a released calculus.
semantic.statement: Interpreted identity binds at least exact calculus identity, subject basis identity, interpretation contract, selected model content identity and semantic-selection ledger identity/digest. Carrier identity binds at least exact interpreted identity, carrier Product or cut, encoding profile and canonical carrier content identity. Semantic acceptance points to unchanged interpreted identity/digest and stays external to both identities; encoding mechanically verifies that match and retains acceptance as evidence. Admission points to unchanged carrier identity/digest; admitted encoding is the external triple (a_c.X.C, J_X, D_C). Product acceptance/release likewise point to content-first identities. The owning Product defines downstream canonical grammar and issuance authority but cannot omit upstream identities or replace them with mutable locators. Publication binding is issued under RELEASE and AC-020 after exact package bytes exist, tying this member and §1 governing clauses to the same package. Released-calculus dependencies bind the issued record's identity, release, manifest and member digests; mutable authoring copies and unissued records cannot substitute.
semantic.uncertainty: Downstream canonical grammars and issuance authorities are intentionally delegated and not specified here.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Application boundary

semantic.statement: The member defines generic interpretation and carrier relations without selecting, constructing, accepting or releasing concrete instances. Downstream authority owns exact subject population, interpretation, carrier, judgments and Product/release status. Downstream identity is never embedded back in the calculus or publication basis.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Constraint surfaces

conditions: For a task projection from an interpreted subject.
semantic.statement: Use task subject/work boundary as seed Z and its declared dependency family R: project(M_subject,Z,R) under AC-011 over AC-010 material closure. Surface objects/meanings come from M_Z semantic objects with AC-002 identity and AC-017 provenance; predicates/dependencies from constraints and typed relations under AC-007/AC-004, sharing one premise record across several constraints without imposing tree shape or execution order; operations from closure traversals/transformations with preconditions and operation authority; results from constraint judgment kinds/outcomes mapped under AC-007; freedom from AC-008 latitude; authority retained per record under AC-005, with none granted by the surface; evidence from judgments and evidence/provenance/basis under AC-014/AC-006; unresolved conditions from AC-009 residuals and AC-011 Boundary_Z seams.
semantic.uncertainty: Full closure, projection, transformation and record laws referenced by the construction are absent.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Constraint surfaces
AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Constraint surfaces

conditions: Whenever a constraint surface is used.
semantic.statement: Preserve each element's recorded standing as premise, derived consequence, policy choice, observation or unresolved claim; retain policy ownership and never turn preference into obligation. Construction/assurance elements keep their recorded kind among FOUNDATIONS' five support kinds: formula is not discharge, and externally assessed predicates retain establishing source, scope and evidence. A residual, hold, gap or unestablished external predicate retains source and required acquisition and blocks every dependent operation/result until its premise is established. Missing premises and omitted obligations grant neither permission nor satisfaction. A surface carries constraints and acquisition routes, not observations, effect grants or task context; ACTIVATION §2 acquisition obtains those from workspace and selected authoritative inputs, and workspace remains the reacquisition basis.
semantic.uncertainty: The five support-kind definitions and detailed acquisition protocol are not supplied.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Constraint surfaces
AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Constraint surfaces

conditions: For source/basis binding, derived fidelity, qualification and ordinary entry.
semantic.statement: Bind exact represented subject separately from calculus basis/signature. Different subject bytes or unestablished basis yield refusal(basis)=invalid_basis. The surface is a derived view of owning prose, not another owner; changing permitted/required work is a fidelity defect repaired at the causal source or derivation. Approximation declares adequacy relation and end-to-end bound. Structural validity may be checked mechanically, fidelity needs semantic judgment, and task sufficiency is shown only through actual use. Mechanical projection requires a separately selected checking contract; none of those claims grants operation or acceptance authority. This section itself selects, constructs and accepts no interpretation. Downstream authority owns the interpretation and its currency; ordinary entry selects the current exact interpretation with limits, marking earlier ones historical.
semantic.uncertainty: Detailed checking, adequacy and task-qualification contracts are delegated to absent owners.

grounds.heading: AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS/9. Application boundary, imports and exclusions/Exclusions

semantic.statement: a_c is none of: representation/compression of its derivation source; selected subject semantic model; carrier profile/instance; executable language, interpreter, compiler implementation or runtime; deterministic semantic assessor/theorem prover; required storage topology; domain ontology; authority registry; or assertion of a universal vocabulary/relation set across governed systems.

conditions: For review and qualification of the calculus member.
semantic.statement: Cover at least: closed signature, RecordKind_ac, populations, fields, value/reference domains; well-typed positive/refusal examples for every fundamental law; identity uniqueness and cross-context collisions; closure/projection/overlay/transformation/composition, including exact model identities, population partitions, basis equality and byte-or-typed-equality preservation refusal; strict operation/kind/actor/judgment separation; residual/authority conservation through interpretation/encoding; exact calculus-basis reconstruction; direct-coordinate, cross-family, wrong-family, duplicate-family and dangling-reference refusal cases for every fundamental record family; derivation/publication reconstruction with cyclic and same-carrier counterexamples; and one neutral toy model exposing no hidden derivation-source-record, application-profile or carrier dependency. No example, checker, model or carrier qualifies a law beyond its exact evaluated claim.
semantic.uncertainty: The referenced full signatures, record families and other laws are not supplied.

conditions: For case execution, assessment and pass claims.
semantic.statement: A run alone is not a pass. Assessment against the declared predicate must observe the expected distinction without coerced success anywhere, returning satisfied for a pass. A case that cannot run with its declared subject is a planned evaluation not performed: it has no result and is explicitly recorded not run. Catalogue or coverage-map presence proves no execution or qualification. Core values and refinements retain their imported owners and mappings.
semantic.uncertainty: No run, assessment or pass is asserted by this interpretation.

conditions: For the respective C-01–C-06 situations.
semantic.statement: C-01: capability-fit activation without allowance refuses or records missing allowance and reports spend/unavailability (ACTIVATION §6). C-02: for 40 rows labelled proven with literal PENDING fields, inspect underlying data and return falsified for rows, not satisfied for labels (EVALUATION §§2,4). C-03: eight from-scratch restarts repeating a method-stance defect require the restart proposal to explain why retained-work repair is insufficient; locate the defect at its owner and reprice it instead of rerunning (ACTIVATION §5). C-04: repeated unchanged-basis derivation at handoff requires counting per-handoff reads/derivations and replacing repetition with applicable reuse (ACTIVATION §7; FOUNDATIONS §4). C-05: parsing a 504.8 MB manifest for 182 entries requires declared exact-identity selective acquisition and counted transferred context without trimming required members (ACTIVATION §2). C-06: distinguish a 2.4 GB report's volume from model traffic in cost records (ACTIVATION §6).
semantic.uncertainty: The named local mechanisms are references; their full rules are not supplied.

conditions: For the respective C-07–C-12 situations.
semantic.statement: C-07: intake names operational variables; changed provider permission profile returns invalid_basis before effects (ACTIVATION §1). C-08: engine completeness amid Product-outcome regression is judged only against the selected outcome, which evidence surfaces cannot enlarge (SPEC_METHOD §3). C-09: a kernel deciding the worker's question requires declared boundary and re_enter at the owning misallocated relation (ODD §5; FOUNDATIONS §2 Work boundary). C-10: a fixture simplified around a kernel defect requires owner triage before repair, framework correction and fixture restoration (SPEC_METHOD §4). C-11: reviewer sign-off cannot close work whose stated condition is unmet; closure follows that condition and reviewer result is input only (EVALUATION §5). C-12: ticket/column/filename-only findings are judged by ambiguity removed, with carrier findings costed as churn (ACTIVATION §6).

conditions: For each applicable construction trial, with declarations before every run.
semantic.statement: T-01: basis exceeding one actor cap, tighter repeats and a coupled cannot-fit case preserve the outer contract through independently assessed refinement; cannot-fit yields out_of_frame or lawful escalation, never omission. T-02: sufficient but ambiguous small-feature intent has ambiguity resolved or explicit and meets independently owned acceptance. T-03: joining two valid bounded results preserves all inputs, constraints, judgments and evidence and refuses an incompatible producing-step composition boundary. T-04: observed failure and required unassessed obligation both survive without composite success. T-05: pause/context-clear/new actor recovers valid progress/basis and detects unsupported completion and needless restarts. T-06: revised requirement reopens affected claims and reuses unaffected results with explicit dependencies. T-07: structurally passing but behaviourally defective candidate is detected or evidential limits reported; structural green is not acceptance. T-08: sourced decision analysis with uncertainty/staleness keeps facts, assumptions, judgments and authority distinct and is independently assessable. Before every run declare per-actor cap/fit and total-work resource budget; include required basis larger than cap, count context across every delegate, keep acceptance independent of constructor and vary task order in probabilistic repeats.
semantic.uncertainty: ACTIVATION's fit and resource-limit definitions are referenced but not supplied.

conditions: For R-01 and R-02; comparative obligations apply when an improvement is claimed.
semantic.statement: R-01 gives a fresh actor only the corpus for bounded activation on a declared subject; governing-relation recovery has independently judged fidelity and records reconstruction cost, task completion and material errors. Comparative claims select an exact comparable baseline, run the same task under matched acquisition conditions, supply matched supporting evidence and explain adverse differences. R-02 repeats without validator folklore, author memory or whole-corpus loading and must succeed or truthfully return out_of_frame.

conditions: For discriminators 32, 33, 38, 42 and 43 and their CD-01–CD-03 actual-use cases.
semantic.statement: These distinctions require fresh-constructor actual use on a declared subject with assessment in addition to textual logical review. CD-01 (32,33; ACTIVATION §1 Configuration, §3 Effects, §5; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §16): peer actors without central coordinator or familiar responsibility names, alongside an installed release Executive, are judged by task, dependencies, limits, authority and assurance; labels/topology neither accept nor reject, and installed configuration retains its own scope. A handoff of uncertain external effect preserves outstanding obligations/dependent results, resolves completion before next dependent action and retains admitted authority/required independence; self-organisation provides no exemption. CD-02 (42,43; SPEC_METHOD §11 rules 1,2,4; EVALUATION §3): software and mixed human/software realisations of the same requirements each provide computational calculus, execution binding and evidence, judged by requirements rather than executor kind. A faster plan merging required independent assessments or automating a required human decision is falsified for each weakened obligation; output equality, cost and speed do not discharge losses. CD-03 (38; ACTIVATION §5 workspace/account, §3 Effects and Construction availability, §7): fresh actor reconciles stale summary with current subject/authoritative inputs, corrects account, retains applicable work and continues within grant; the out-of-grant disagreement stops with re_entry_requested(authority). Summary cannot override workspace; clearing context erases no workspace; missing effect record leaves completion_unknown, not absent.
semantic.uncertainty: Referenced operational owners are not supplied; the cases describe expected behaviour, not an executed workflow.

conditions: For each applicable positive, negative and unresolved assurance case.
semantic.statement: Each applicable AR case requires its own exact execution and assessment record, with no catalogue-implied run/result. AR-01: each actual-use expectation set includes a necessary condition a wrong decision can satisfy; satisfied establishes only that condition, supplies no correct-frame-use claim and is excluded from benefit attribution, while falsified remains a failed run condition (FOUNDATIONS §4 Assertions and observation). AR-02: each set records two admissible returns, one correct, one incorrect, indistinguishable at the observation; grade indeterminate with that reason, never satisfied/falsified. A return matching neither is listed for diagnosis because item or return may be at fault. AR-03: expectation writer, actors and grader from one model family, with writer/actors reading shared owners, do not create independent evidence by agreement. Diagnose disagreement among ACTIVATION §1's four causes, including expectation error; assume no statistical independence from families/codebases; name donors/common dependencies of ported material (FOUNDATIONS §4 Parallel derivation). AR-04: for two changed and nine added owning sections, dependent curated frames, hashed expectation sets, interpretation and conservation readings whose validity dependencies meet impact cover are reassessed or invalidated until rebuilt; frames regenerate/tests rerun, and interpretation lacking added-section coverage stays invalidated. An expectation set with unchanged deciding sentences may remain with validity conditions stated; hash change alone decides nothing (FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact, S_Δ and retain_applicable; ACTIVATION §7).
semantic.uncertainty: The four diagnostic causes and full formal assurance relations are not supplied.

conditions: For each applicable coverage row, read against material member and consumer scope.
exceptions: Interpretation and optional-profile cases apply only when that surface or claim is selected; mere availability creates no implementation obligation.
semantic.statement: Logical review constructs each situation against the text and finds the expected distinction, a counterexample or contradiction without running anything; its reviewer must meet EVALUATION §3 and result follows §4. Mechanical/structural checking does not establish this review, which supplies no actual-use evidence. Actual use adds evidence without replacing applicable textual reading. Required frame results carry core algebra or mapped refinement. Mapping denotes possible exercise, not execution/pass; a selected case without current assessment remains planned with no closed result.
semantic.uncertainty: Reviewer eligibility and review-result contracts are outside this source.

conditions: For coverage discriminators 1–10; L-n is the corresponding logical-review check.
semantic.statement: 1: show every claimed derivation's premises and argue independence rather than assume it (FOUNDATIONS §§1,3; EVALUATION §1; L-1 premises shown). 2: family arguments cover material inherited/edited rules and actual declared-family consumers or support no separate consumer; blank/generic/coarser/preamble substitutes cannot supply missing relations (FOUNDATIONS §3 tables/family index; every member family table). 3: a new introduction plus unchanged rival consumer rules is only correspondence; deciding consumers must use shared determination or justified refinement (FOUNDATIONS §§2,3; ACTIVATION §§1–7; EVALUATION §§3,5). 4: shorter text is no reduction witness; comparative claims compare actual deciding paths/acquisition with exact comparable baseline (FOUNDATIONS §3; README; shared owners). 5: shared-law use must preserve outcomes and necessary domain exception ownership; no universal reduction percentage/word decrease is needed (FOUNDATIONS §4 refinements, §2 imports; refining members). 6: outcome-driven contracts govern construction, evaluation, continuation, recovery and termination with independent cases and justified extra policies, without requiring optional typed-graph adoption (ACTIVATION §§1,4,5; ODD §1). 7: one successor law may conserve multiple predecessor claims without old partitions, but each material obligation/consumer binding is evaluated and bare links cannot replace meaning (RELEASE §9; work-carrier dispositions). 8: size reduction cannot erase material exceptions: valid disposition preserves required behaviour or obtains owning removal decision (same owners). 9: shared-law replacement retains material trigger, modal force, adoption conditions and exceptions, with noncircular owner/domain determination (FOUNDATIONS §2; referring members). 10: generic rules remain obtainable without optional-profile adoption; profile additions retain selection boundary (FOUNDATIONS §3; PROFILES §1; IDENTITY §2; ACTIVATION §1).
semantic.uncertainty: Most deciding owner clauses are referenced only; this preserves catalogue expectations, not independently reconstructed owner laws.

conditions: For coverage discriminators 11–20; each uses its matching L-n check.
exceptions: For discriminator 18, an authorised successor relation may establish changed permitted work.
semantic.statement: 11: promoting a helper requires a material distinction/independent boundary; names and shared machinery create no semantic/authority owner (DESIGN_MODULE §4; ACTIVATION §6). 12: a small interface proves no Markov sufficiency/independence; state assumptions/evidence and leave unsupported claims unresolved (IDENTITY §2; WORLD_MODEL §4; FOUNDATIONS §5). 13: a schema-passing model omitting a condition fails fidelity for affected decisions and cannot authorise source-prohibited work (AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §6, AC-017/018; EVALUATION §2). 14: a faithful fragment proves only covered scope; whole-method claims require every material owned determination/dependency (same owners). 15: assess projected frames against source fidelity/task sufficiency; different encoding alone is no defect, changed obligations/permissions are (AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §9; ACTIVATION §2). 16: unresolved premises retain dependencies and applicable stop/acquisition/refinement, never unrestricted freedom or permission grants (AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §9, AC-009; ACTIVATION §1). 17: permit alternative solutions satisfying contract; internal strategy stays with worker (AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §9, AC-008). 18: changing not-required to prohibited or preference to obligation is a fidelity defect absent authorised successor change; digest/schema agreement cannot repair it (EVALUATION §7; AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS AC-008, §9). 19: ordinary entry binds current source, signature, program, maps, instructions and evidence boundary and reproduces its route; older artifacts stay historical. Stale-input refusal contains failure without proving usable current publication or coverage (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §11; ACTIVATION §2; README). 20: structural agreement between information/representation establishes neither identical meaning nor semantic fidelity (EVALUATION §§2,6; AC-017/018; L-20 structure is not meaning).
semantic.uncertainty: Referenced ownership and selection details outside supplied sections remain unresolved.

conditions: For coverage discriminators 21–30.
semantic.statement: 21: stable identity with changed content requires separate consideration of current state and old observation applicability (FOUNDATIONS §2 Object; IDENTITY §2; RF-005; ACTIVATION §7; L-21). 22: producer/consumer domain or precondition incompatibility is explicit; same-shaped fields do not validate a join (FOUNDATIONS §4; AC-004/016; T-03 and L-22). 23: retain authenticated A failure/citations and unresolved uncovered B; authenticate each planned assessment judgment against producer, subject, basis and evidence. B is required coverage outside planned assessments, not an omitted planned judgment (FOUNDATIONS §4 conjunction; T-04 and L-23). 24: plan membership cannot authenticate a wrong-subject judgment or satisfy its obligation (FOUNDATIONS §4 second input; EVALUATION §2; RF-005; L-24). 25: interdependent context exceeding capacity requires lawful narrowing, capable handoff or truthful stop preserving obligations (ACTIVATION §2 step 3, §4; RF-014; T-01). 26: byte-fit alone proves no adequacy; retain material dependencies, exclude irrelevant material and assess actual frame use (ACTIVATION §2 steps 2/3; EVALUATION §7; RF-003/004; L-26 plus frame qualification). 27: changed frame/task or answer-supplying instructions require exact tested packet and independent expectations; report narrower evidence, since rewritten trials or matching pins prove no current sufficiency (EVALUATION §§7,3; L-27). 28: fresh context is not independent authorship/authority; ported contributions retain authorship and contributors cannot independently accept them, though independent reviewers may share relevant common sources (EVALUATION §3; ACTIVATION §1 reconfiguration; L-28). 29: excluded frontier work stays open, with next-decision dependencies retained (ACTIVATION §1; RF-015; L-29). 30: discovery can enlarge frontier while improving knowledge; counts alone prove no progress. Revised destination needs owner decision and cannot prove original attainment (ACTIVATION §§1,5; L-30).

conditions: For coverage discriminators 31–40.
semantic.statement: 31: a directly authorised task fitting a sufficient frame permits direct activation subject to separately required assessment, with no fixed role inventory/actor sequence (ACTIVATION §1; L-31). 32: peer/no-Executive/unfamiliar-role configurations are judged by task, dependencies, limits, authority and assurance; labels/topology neither reject nor accept; adopted configurations keep scope (ACTIVATION §1; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §16; CD-01). 33: redistribution preserves obligations/dependencies, resolves material effect uncertainty before dependent action and retains authority/independence, with no self-organisation exemption (ACTIVATION §§1,3,5; CD-01). 34: adequacy differs from optimality; optimality requires objectives, constraints, comparison scope and evidence, with different models/objectives possibly favouring different configurations (ACTIVATION §1; L-34). 35: compact results must not hide delivery blockers; coordinator retains longer-term outcome and acquires next-decision information through permitted frame inputs, never assumes missing information favourable (ACTIVATION §§1,7; L-35). 36: changed dependencies/new invalidating evidence trigger applicability/validity checks before reuse even with unchanged bytes; keep demonstrably independent supported work. A declaration-preserving frame revision's harmless metadata permits reuse after exact consumer applicability check; new evidence bearing on closure or discovered out-of-family activation reopens results and consuming coverage before reliance (ACTIVATION §§7,1; EVALUATION §2; REFERENCE_FRAME §10; T-06 and L-36). 37: relevant rules without material context/authority are insufficient; activated frame binds contract, subject, evidence, capability and permitted effects (REFERENCE_FRAME §11; ACTIVATION §§1,2; L-37). 38: reconcile fresh-actor summary against current authoritative workspace, retain applicable work and stay within grant; cleared context proves no uncertain effect absent (ACTIVATION §§5,3; CD-03). 39: partial-write recovery uses current workspace/applicable state without erasing progress or inventing completed assessment (ACTIVATION §5; FOUNDATIONS §4 Not performed; T-05 and L-39). 40: parse/map success remains mechanical until independently sufficient semantic and practical evidence exists (EVALUATION §§2,7; AC-018/019; T-07 and L-40).

conditions: For coverage discriminators 41–52.
semantic.statement: 41: proposed carrier/process law needs purpose/material justification or is unsupported overhead (ACTIVATION §6; SPEC_METHOD §4; TICKETS §5; L-41). 42: software, human and mixed tenants each supply calculus, execution binding and evidence; requirements decide fitness, executor kind does not. Preserve permitted adequate human processes using current records/direct observation without code or full event-history replay (SPEC_METHOD §11 rules 1,2,4; CD-02). 43: faster assessment-merging or human-decision automation fails conformance despite matching outputs/lower cost (SPEC_METHOD §11 rules 2,4; EVALUATION §3; CD-02). 44: each environment binding satisfies calculus laws; different stacks require no duplicate calculus, and actor identity decides neither operation kind nor authority (SPEC_METHOD §11 rules 2,5; L-44). 45: structural validation of a human-process model selects no automated executor and proves no execution fitness, which needs applicable evidence (SPEC_METHOD §11 rule 6; AC-018; L-45). 46: one locus owns a question; others refer or refine with mapping back, frame copies name owner, and precedence is no substitute (FOUNDATIONS §2 imports; PRODUCT_DEFINITION §11; L-46). 47: each owner-defined result maps declared predicate and meaning conditions to exactly one core value without raised standing; predicate/domain outcome travel with it. At 12:01, evidence of only three of five updates required by 12:00 is not_effected=falsified with two missing updates as counterexample and unknown ending as residual; lost response without counterexample is completion_unknown=indeterminate; neither repeats before reconciliation (FOUNDATIONS §4; ACTIVATION §3; result-defining members/profiles; L-47). 48: lifecycle/classification data remains distinct from admission/compliance/closure decisions; actual determination uses core contract, and data labels/core referrals cannot replace domain mappings (FOUNDATIONS §4; ACTIVATION §3; TICKETS §3; SPEC_METHOD §2; L-48). 49: compare required/permitted decisions on the same material case including modality, triggers, scope and exceptions; indicative grammar does not settle meaning. Superseded claims name replacement relation/owners and proposed replacements stay pending until accepted (RELEASE §9; work-carrier dispositions; L-49). 50: every result-returning frame carries core algebra or profile mapping (RF-012, §11; ACTIVATION §2; L-50). 51: categorical functor/join claims require objects, arrows, arrow equality, identity, composition and demonstrated laws before the claim; otherwise hypothesis (FOUNDATIONS §4; EVALUATION §6; AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5; L-51). 52: rewrite/refinement declares its permitting subject law; exact preserves meaning, approximate declares adequacy/end-to-end bound (ACTIVATION §4; L-52).

conditions: For integrated assessment of the complete declared member set and material composition, including J53–J59.
exceptions: Existing applicable evidence may support several cases; no separate run per table row or complete fresh execution is required where governing assurance is established.
semantic.statement: Review and acceptance remain distinct EVALUATION-owned acts; local success cannot discharge shared contradiction, unresolved owner decision or required-result gap. J53: separately satisfied members do not erase cross-member contradiction; assess shared owners/composition. J54: reviewer agreement supports a replacement proposal but dependent acceptance waits for exact owner replacement decision on work carrier; construction grant supplies none. J55: missing, stale or falsified required criteria withhold acceptance under conjunction while preserving components; favourable verdict cannot replace evidence; supported conditional inapplicability is separate and waives no applicable mandatory criterion. J56: control success alongside candidate-frame failure preserves applicable task judgment, proves neither fixture answer leakage nor removal of frame-use failure; benefit attribution and applicability corrections need their own claim/reason. J57: assess actual path from selected outcome through bounded work, observation, diagnosis and lawful continuation/closure, using independently specified actual-use expectations; prose alone proves no use. J58: join source obligation, interpreted predicate, observed subject and supported conclusion, exposing weak assertion, insufficient observation and shared error while retaining bounded standings. J59: supported repair impact selects reassessment, retains known failures and unknown coverage and combines new evidence with justified reuse; demonstrate both valid retention and missed-dependency/changed-oracle cases.
semantic.uncertainty: The full conjunction and acceptance protocols remain external references.

grounds.heading: CONFORMANCE/5. Discriminator coverage/Universal-construction and assurance discriminators

conditions: For UC-1–UC-9; each has its corresponding L-UCn check, with UC-9 also exercised by CD-03.
semantic.statement: UC-1: internal success with required end-to-end failure retains outer failure and diagnoses affected join; local completion proves no Z (ACTIVATION §1; FOUNDATIONS §4 preservation; EVALUATION §1). UC-2: lawful operations with unmet outcome constraints distinguish admissible construction from delivery; specification supplies Z, calculus/execution implies no satisfaction/acceptance (ACTIVATION §1 Binding A and Z; SPEC_METHOD §11). UC-3: bug labels do not decide implementation/requirement/observation cause or repair permission; use one intake/diagnosis, correct supported affected relation or acquire evidence and retain alternatives (ACTIVATION §1; SPEC_METHOD §4). UC-4: weakened Z needs owner decision/downstream re-entry and proves neither former Z nor erasure of original counterexample (ACTIVATION §1; SPEC_METHOD §4; FOUNDATIONS §4 parallel derivation). UC-5: predictive accuracy and normative outcome satisfaction are separate predicates/support, neither determining the other (ACTIVATION §1 three accounts/diagnosis). UC-6: select strategy within outcome constraints by material resource/risk/feedback tradeoffs, with no cost waiver; preserve incomparable alternatives and unsupported estimates (ACTIVATION §1; FOUNDATIONS §4 quantified assurance; EXECUTIVE_BASELINE Steel-thread). UC-7: invariant preservation alone proves no progress/termination; give actual continuation support or unresolved stop, without imposing generic termination proof for bounded work (ACTIVATION §1; FOUNDATIONS §3). UC-8: distinguish attempt termination, discovery, ongoing maintenance and delivery; elapsed work/count changes alone decide none (ACTIVATION §§1,6). UC-9: restart/disturbance contradicting cache requires current-subject reacquisition, affected-claim reopening, independent-work preservation and sufficient effect-uncertainty resolution before dependent action (ACTIVATION §§5,7; CD-03).
semantic.uncertainty: Owner definitions of A, Z and governing construction relations are not fully supplied.

grounds.heading: CONFORMANCE/5. Discriminator coverage/Universal-construction and assurance discriminators

conditions: For AS-1–AS-6; each has L-ASn, with AS-2/3/6 also exercised by AR-01/02/03 respectively.
semantic.statement: AS-1: local success without postcondition-to-next-precondition preservation or final-property-to-Z coverage requires the missing argument, withholds unsupported end-to-end conclusion and retains local support (FOUNDATIONS §4 preservation). AS-2: correct histogram keys with wrong counts shows a key-only test's predicate limit; assertion provenance distinguishes necessary from sufficient, and faithful count assertion detects the count defect within scope (FOUNDATIONS §4 assertions; AR-01). AS-3: opposite-truth admissible states with identical observations preclude sound complete decision from those observations; acquire distinguishing evidence, justify narrower scope or return indeterminate, distinguishing unavailable observation from non-performance (same owner; AR-02). AS-4: implementation-copied expectations plus requirement digest prove neither assertion fidelity nor independent upstream derivation; supported local regression claims remain usable (FOUNDATIONS §4 parallel derivation). AS-5: where human/probabilistic checker soundly admits satisfied or indeterminate on identical observations, the model admits both; universal soundness covers all admitted conclusions, deterministic selection keeps scope, probability needs distribution/evidence (FOUNDATIONS §4 assertions). AS-6: differing actors agreeing through shared wrong interpretation/fixture/contribution do not supply independence; expose common causes and port authorship, and validate common expectation using its separate purpose/evidence (FOUNDATIONS §4 parallel derivation; AR-03).
semantic.uncertainty: Formal proofs, observation models and independence evidence are not present.

grounds.heading: CONFORMANCE/5. Discriminator coverage/Universal-construction and assurance discriminators
CONFORMANCE/5. Discriminator coverage/Universal-construction and assurance discriminators

conditions: For AS-7–AS-12 and all claims based on the listed finite models or case mappings.
exceptions: Applicable unchanged evidence may be retained where isolation and validity conditions are supported; full re-execution is not required solely because the subject changed.
semantic.statement: AS-7/L-AS7: multiplying miss rates or promoting injected-defect scores to whole-Product correctness requires model, justified dependence and calibration scope; unsupported quantification stays unresolved while bounded observations survive (FOUNDATIONS §4 quantified assurance). AS-8/L-AS8: finite successes/schema-valid formula are no universal preservation proof; formal obligation, discharged argument, structure and bounded execution retain distinct scopes, with bounded work allowed under governing conditions (FOUNDATIONS §4 formal representation; AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §9 condition 1). AS-9/AR-04/L-AS9: changed governing requirements trigger owner-authorised reassessment of affected assertions/applicability; original evidence/counterexamples retain subjects (FOUNDATIONS §4 change impact; ACTIVATION §7). AS-10/L-AS10: impact includes material execution/validity dependencies, not just requirement-to-test provenance; missing influence cannot justify exclusion, uncovered obligations generate work and mandatory gates remain (FOUNDATIONS §4 change impact). AS-11/L-AS11: supported isolated repair permits unchanged applicable evidence plus affected reassessment, without automatic full rerun. AS-12/L-AS12: selection accounts for required assurance, residual uncertainty and total relevant cost; broader execution is available, and cheap selection/fixed full-suite habits prove neither adequacy nor efficiency (FOUNDATIONS §4 change impact/quantified assurance). Every case receives local logical review and actual-use evidence where its claim requires it; finite-model properties stay within declared model/population, mechanical validity grants no semantic fidelity or whole-Product conformance. Execution records independently bind current subjects/evidence; mapping neither proves pass nor exempts material owners/consumers from review.

semantic.statement: Import FOUNDATIONS, ACTIVATION, EVALUATION, IDENTITY, SPEC_METHOD, ASSURANCE, TICKETS and RELEASE by reference without redefining their objects. Ownership remains: proportionality at ACTIVATION §6; execution unit/seam at §1; complete enclosing-relation admission at §4; authority identity at IDENTITY §6; shared machinery at FOUNDATIONS §4; realisation core/non-goals at SPEC_METHOD §2; design-to-module evidence, module-derived tests and lifecycle confirmation at ASSURANCE §§14–16. ODD graph-execution and UX profiles refine/bound DESIGN_MODULE where their own scopes apply. Each profile clause names its requiring P0–P6 principle.

conditions: For performed profile evaluations, design dispositions and record entries.
semantic.statement: Performed evaluations return core values directly or via the two locally mapped refinements: §7 reconstruction decisions and cross-view axiom verdicts. Ontology/design verdicts are ACTIVATION §3 dispositions as specified by §7 Gate and retrospective work. Function-derivation dispositions, entity-lifecycle entries, discovery-category/unsupported-admission not_applicable entries, competing-path dispositions, IACS revision classes, reference mappings, two-part algorithmic-obligation dispositions and module roles are author-declared assessed records, not results, and map to no core value. Their evaluations return separate core values. A not_applicable record entry records an exclusion with no result for the excluded obligation under ACTIVATION applicability/core exclusions; a not_applicable axiom verdict is instead a mapped predicate value for a disjunction including non-application. Consumers must never combine record entries as results.
