grounds.heading: TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Execution and verification authority separation (UP-007)

exceptions: Independent assessment is not required for every local implementation step.
A governing basis may add independent-assessment boundaries.
semantic.statement: Independent review is required at product, qualification, release and explicitly risk-bearing boundaries claiming it. Required reviews identify exact subject/basis/scope/exclusions/evidence/verdict/unresolved findings, and findings cite current authority plus code/proof paths rather than historical commentary alone. Human acceptance/rejection cannot make self-review independent. Claimed review supports promotion/closure only with durable exact subject/verdict traceability in existing ticket/commentary/qualification/release evidence; occurrence statements, unbound summaries and unavailable drafts are not verdicts. Verdicts stay within exact claim/hard stops; external EVALUATION §5 owns blocking findings and no trigger is added here. Human rulings receive durable disposition before the next affected acceptance boundary, keep source wording separate, and cannot be widened or discharged merely by opening a ticket. Where agentic construction applies, active work identifies selected basis, bounded affected relations, delegated construction/assessment authority and re-entry; references to existing design/evidence may suffice. Ticket state/prose/admitted contract cannot widen basis or replace required live-surface assessment. Existing ticket/commentary/commit/qualification/release carriers may hold transition evidence; no extra receipt, state, document, round or ceremony is required.
semantic.uncertainty: Independence protocol, finding hard stops and agentic execution semantics remain external.

grounds.heading: TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity

exceptions: Required independent assessment must acquire sufficient exact evidence and supply its own independent judgment; reusing author J does not meet independence.
semantic.statement: Later roles/runs recover judgments and check applicability rather than reauthor unchanged conclusions. Changed material facts/evidence, declared revising observation or basis invalidate affected results; preserve originals and successor links, retaining only demonstrably independent results and reassessing affected scope. Current C may be referenced but unknown facts cannot become established premises by reuse. Owner rulings are reused without widening or asking unchanged authority again; new ambiguity or material decision change returns only the affected question to owner. J is not O; recording either creates no admission, acceptance, effects or continuation beyond grant. Results follow selected run/sprint/ticket and named evidence-surface lifetime, without a separate registry, ticket per judgment or extra approval ceremony.
semantic.uncertainty: Full C/J/O annotation and generic reuse definitions are external.

grounds.heading: TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity

semantic.statement: Repricing gives each affected obligation a retained/superseded/deferred/withdrawn disposition with owner and evidence in the same carrier; preserves surviving work, explains changed dependencies and does not copy unaffected history to parallel ledgers. Present owner decisions as short consequence deltas with original ruling separate; generic continuation does not accept undisclosed architecture/scope change. Performed repricing evaluation retains decision/state/evidence and all applicable failure grounds: established requires exact owner authority/evidence/conditions and surviving-obligation preservation; falsified requires a counterexample including exceeding grant or violating obligation; indeterminate retains undecided condition/needed evidence; out_of_frame retains undeclared material relation/capability; invalid_basis covers absent/stale/ambiguous/mismatched required basis. No performed evaluation means no result. Evaluation grants no decision authority; only authorized owner act changes state. Lawful deferral may satisfy repricing while delivery remains failed/outstanding. Unauthorized withdrawn cannot close; retention or satisfied repricing proves no delivery; supersession/deferral/withdrawal erase no unresolved obligation/evidence.

grounds.heading: TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Condition-based closure and reuse

exceptions: Where applicable law requires neither independent review nor reserved acceptance, recording without review follows the referenced existing-carrier route; sprint-close and applicable design-profile law still apply.
semantic.statement: Completion requires every applicable declared obligation satisfied by valid exact-subject/basis/scope evidence, every required judgment/ruling present and applicable, and no active non-closure condition. Unknown applicability or insufficient evidence for a mandatory obligation withholds dependent claim; the existing owner decides reserved acceptance. This is the referenced conjunction with obligations as required coverage, and SPEC_METHOD applies it over change spans. Review evaluates conditions but is not the closing event. Unchanged obligations reuse valid evidence/J/O. Material counterexamples, changed evidence, declared J revising observations and changed basis invalidate affected claim/dependent results before further reliance. Unrelated observations remain bounded repricing input and neither automatically reopen satisfied claims nor expand work. Closure recording preserves exact evaluated scope, satisfied conditions, evidence and residuals.
semantic.uncertainty: Full conjunction and recording-without-review protocols are external.

grounds.heading: TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Test case authority

semantic.statement: Tests derive no authority from implementation. Acceptance predicates require an applicable supported entry/state and obligation under governing operating/threat model; existing tests authorize no excluded threat or superseded guard. Changed responsibility requires predicate audit and retirement of unsupported expectations under owner basis, without invented replacement guards. Live-authority conflict requires re-entry, not test waiver. For code/test mismatch after a ticket fix, reconcile in order: (1) ticket intent/class/re-entry/target/superseded truth/closure/evaluation/non-closure fields; (2) triage and lawful owner re-entry; (3) governing requirement/design/module/function/carrier/other authority; (4) test expectation; (5) implementation. Code may reveal stale/incomplete/narrow tests but cannot alone authorize expectation changes. Updating/removing a pre-repricing test requires named governing ticket and superseding authority change. Stale/ambiguous/under-authorized ticket re-enters triage before code or test is treated correct. A passing test is closure evidence only with expectation traced to admitted ticket and authority chain.
semantic.uncertainty: ASSURANCE §3's general law is not supplied.

grounds.heading: TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/One-truth state projection and drift refusal (UP-009)

semantic.statement: One work-state authority chain assigns bounded wave to goals, ticket state to ticket, subordinate milestone state to milestone authority, and realisation decisions to accepted design. Projection recency/visibility/repetition confers no truth. Contradictions among owning ticket, required milestones, current goals or cited acceptance evidence block closure. Superseded evidence remains history and must not appear as current acceptance.

semantic.statement: partial_effect(not_attained) requires admitted effect evidence and bounded post-observation, interpreted under IntendedOutcome's outcome contract and comparison basis, establishing both non-attainment and that no later completion can attain it. Evidence of the effect's end is not required for that cause; an unestablished end is retained in the residual. Lost responses, absent records and an actor context lacking traces establish neither non-attainment nor effect termination. transition_evaluation partial inherits its partial_effect stop's cause. Neither mapped core value records actual mutation or termination; partial_effect residual and re-entry preserve both through every join. Falsified does not mean absent; indeterminate means neither absent nor complete; neither establishes termination. Explicit re-entry precedes any further effect, and an effect whose end is unestablished is reconciled under referenced ACTIVATION recovery before repetition.

An authority refusal alone proves no absence: actual or possible unauthorized mutation requires retained invocation, observations and uncertainty, fails refused_effect's evidence condition and follows referenced effect/recovery law. not_effected means intended outcome not attained, not absence of all effects. Where an invocation names an intended effect, mappings for 'the intended effect occurred' are completed_effect→completed→satisfied; partial_effect(not_attained)→not_effected→falsified, retaining performed part and uncertain end; partial_effect(undecided)→completion_unknown→indeterminate; refused_effect→not_effected→falsified; no_effect→not_effected→falsified because none was dispatched.
